title.zh: 卷五十一 志第三下: 五行二
title.raw: 卷五十一 志第三下: 五行二 Volume 51 Treatises 4: Five Elements 2

sentences.zh: 五行二 ○水不潤下

translations.literal: Five Elements, Part 2 ○ Water fails to descend and moisten below
translations.idiomatic: Five Elements, Part 2 ○ Water fails to descend and nourish the land below

sentences.zh: 元統元年五月，汴梁陽武縣河溢害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Yuantong, the river overflowed in Yangwu County, Bianliang, damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Yuantong (1333), the river burst its banks at Yangwu County in the Bianliang region, ruining the harvest.

sentences.zh: 六月，京畿大霖雨，水平地丈餘。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the capital region had great continuous rain; the water stood more than a zhang above level ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the capital region was deluged by prolonged rains, and floodwaters stood more than ten feet deep across the plain.

sentences.zh: 涇河溢，關中水災。

translations.literal: The Jing River overflowed; there was a flood disaster in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing River burst its banks, bringing flood disaster to the Guanzhong region.

sentences.zh: 黃河大溢，河南水災。

translations.literal: The Yellow River overflowed greatly; there was a flood disaster in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River flooded on a vast scale, inundating Henan.

sentences.zh: 泉州霖雨，溪水暴漲，漂民居數百家。

translations.literal: Quanzhou had continuous rain; mountain streams rose violently and swept away several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At Quanzhou, unrelenting rains sent mountain torrents crashing down, washing away several hundred homes along the streams.

sentences.zh: 七月，潮州大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Chaozhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Chaozhou was struck by severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，東平須城縣、濟寧濟州、曹州濟陰縣水災。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, Xucheng County in Dongping, Jizhou in Jining, and Jiyin County in Caozhou suffered flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, flood disasters struck Xucheng County in Dongping, Jizhou in Jining, and Jiyin County in Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 二月，灤河、漆河溢，永平路屬縣皆水。

translations.literal: In the second month, the Luan River and Qi River overflowed; all subordinate counties of Yongping Circuit were inundated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Luan and Qi rivers overflowed, and every county under Yongping Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 瑞州路水。

translations.literal: Ruizhou Circuit was inundated.
translations.idiomatic: Ruizhou Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 三月，山東霖雨，水湧。

translations.literal: In the third month, Shandong had continuous rain and surging waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Shandong saw incessant rain and rising floodwaters.

sentences.zh: 四月，東平、益都水。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Dongping and Yidu were flooded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Dongping and Yidu were inundated.

sentences.zh: 五月，鎮江路水，宣德府大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Zhenjiang Circuit was flooded; Xuande Prefecture suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Zhenjiang Circuit was flooded, and Xuande Prefecture was hit by major flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月，淮河漲，漂山陽縣境內民畜房舍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Huai River rose and swept away people, livestock, and dwellings within Shanyang County.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Huai River swelled and carried off people, livestock, and houses throughout Shanyang County.

sentences.zh: 九月，吉安路水。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Ji'an Circuit was inundated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Ji'an Circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 至元元年，河決汴梁封丘縣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiyuan, the Yellow River broke its banks at Fengqiu County, Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhiyuan, the Yellow River breached its banks at Fengqiu County in the Bianliang region.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，南陽鄧州大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, Nanyang and Dengzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year, Nanyang and Dengzhou were devastated by flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月，涇水溢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Jing River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Jing River burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 八月，大都至通州霖雨，大水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, from the capital to Tongzhou there was continuous rain and great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, torrential rains from the capital to Tongzhou brought severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，紹興大水。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, Shaoxing suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year, Shaoxing was inundated.

sentences.zh: 五月，廣西賀州大水害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Hezhou in Guangxi suffered a great flood that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Hezhou in Guangxi was flooded, destroying the standing crops.

sentences.zh: 六月，衛輝淫雨至七月，丹、沁二河泛漲，與城西御河通流，平地深二丈餘，漂沒人民房舍田禾甚眾，民皆棲於樹木，郡守僧家奴以舟載飯食之，移老弱居城頭，日給糧餉，月餘水方退。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Weihui had excessive rain through the seventh month; the Dan and Qin rivers rose and flooded, joining the Imperial Canal west of the city; on level ground the depth was more than two zhang; very many people, dwellings, and fields were swept away; people all took refuge in trees; the prefect Jiajianu used boats to carry food to feed them; the old and weak were moved to the city wall, grain rations were supplied daily, and only after more than a month did the water recede.
translations.idiomatic: From the sixth month through the seventh, Weihui was battered by incessant rain; the Dan and Qin rivers surged and merged with the Imperial Canal west of the city wall, leaving more than twenty feet of water across the plain. Countless homes, fields, and lives were lost, and survivors clung to trees while Prefect Jiajianu ferried food to them by boat. The elderly and infirm were relocated atop the city wall and given daily rations; more than a month passed before the waters subsided.

sentences.zh: 汴梁蘭陽、尉氏二縣，歸德府皆河水泛溢。

translations.literal: Lanyang and Weishi counties in Bianliang, and Guide Prefecture—all had the river flood and overflow.
translations.idiomatic: In Bianliang, Lanyang and Weishi counties, together with Guide Prefecture, all saw the rivers flood and spill over their banks.

sentences.zh: 黃州及衢州常山縣皆大水。

translations.literal: Huangzhou, and Changshan County in Quzhou, all suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhou and Changshan County in Quzhou were all struck by major floods.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，吉安永豐縣大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Yongfeng County in Ji'an suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Yongfeng County in Ji'an was inundated.

sentences.zh: 六月，邵武大水，城市皆洪流，漂沿溪民居殆盡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Shaowu suffered a great flood; the city was all rushing torrents, and dwellings along the streams were nearly all swept away.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Shaowu was deluged; torrents ran through the city, and homes along the streams were almost entirely washed away.

sentences.zh: 五年六月庚戌，汀州路長汀縣大水，平地深三丈許，損民居八百家，壞民田二百頃，溺死者八千餘人。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the sixth month of the fifth year, Changting County in Tingzhou Circuit suffered a great flood; on level ground the depth was about three zhang; eight hundred households were damaged, two hundred qing of fields were ruined, and more than eight thousand people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month of the fifth year, Changting County in Tingzhou Circuit was flooded to a depth of some thirty feet on level ground. Eight hundred homes were destroyed, two hundred qing of farmland ruined, and more than eight thousand people drowned.

sentences.zh: 七月，沂州沂、沭二河暴漲，決堤防，害田稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Yi and Shu rivers in Yizhou rose violently, broke the dikes, and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Yi and Shu rivers in Yizhou surged, breached the dikes, and destroyed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 邵武光澤縣大水。

translations.literal: Guangze County in Shaowu suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Guangze County in Shaowu was severely flooded.

sentences.zh: 常州宜興縣山水出，勢高一丈，壞民居。

translations.literal: In Yixing County, Changzhou, mountain waters burst forth, the surge standing one zhang high, damaging dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: At Yixing County in Changzhou, mountain floods erupted to a height of ten feet, damaging homes.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，京畿五州十一縣及福州路福寧州大水。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, eleven counties in five prefectures of the capital region and Funing Prefecture in Fuzhou Circuit suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year, great floods struck eleven counties across five prefectures of the capital region, as well as Funing Prefecture in Fuzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，慶元奉化州山崩，水湧出平地，溺死人甚眾。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the fifth month, a mountain collapsed in Fenghua Prefecture, Qingyuan, and water gushed out on level ground; very many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fifth month, a mountainside gave way in Fenghua Prefecture, Qingyuan, sending floodwaters across the plain and drowning a great many people.

sentences.zh: 六月，衢州西安、龍遊二縣大水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Xi'an and Longyou counties in Quzhou suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Xi'an and Longyou counties in Quzhou were inundated.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，處州松陽、龍泉二縣積雨，水漲入城中，深丈餘，溺死五百餘人；

translations.literal: On the gengxu day, Songyang and Longquan counties in Chuzhou had accumulated rain; the water rose into the city to a depth of more than one zhang; more than five hundred people drowned;
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, prolonged rains at Songyang and Longquan counties in Chuzhou sent floodwaters into the cities to a depth of more than ten feet, drowning more than five hundred people;

sentences.zh: 遂昌縣尤甚，平地三丈餘。

translations.literal: Suichang County was especially severe, with more than three zhang on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: Suichang County was hit hardest, with floodwaters more than thirty feet deep across the plain.

sentences.zh: 桃源鄉山崩，壓溺民居五十三家，死者三百六十餘人。

translations.literal: In Taoyuan township a mountain collapsed, crushing and drowning fifty-three households; more than three hundred sixty people died.
translations.idiomatic: In Taoyuan township a mountainside collapsed, burying and drowning fifty-three households and killing more than three hundred sixty people.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，延平南平縣淫雨，水泛漲，溺死百餘人，損民居三百餘家，壞民田二頃七十餘畝。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the seventh month, Nanping County in Yanping had excessive rain; the waters rose and flooded; more than a hundred people drowned; more than three hundred households were damaged; more than two qing and seventy mu of fields were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the seventh month, excessive rains at Nanping County in Yanping sent waters surging through the county, drowning more than a hundred people, destroying more than three hundred homes, and ruining more than two qing and seventy mu of farmland.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，奉元路盩啡縣河水溢，漂溺居民。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, the river in Zhouzhi County, Fengyuan Circuit, overflowed and swept away and drowned the inhabitants.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the river overflowed at Zhouzhi County in Fengyuan Circuit, carrying off and drowning the local population.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，衛輝大水，漂民居一千餘家。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the eighth month, Weihui suffered a great flood that swept away more than a thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the eighth month, Weihui was flooded, washing away more than a thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 十月，河南府宜陽縣大水，漂民居，溺死者眾。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Yiyang County in Henan Prefecture suffered a great flood that swept away dwellings; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Yiyang County in Henan Prefecture was inundated, homes were swept away, and a great many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 至正元年，汴梁鈞州大水，揚州路崇明、通、泰等州海潮湧溢，溺死一千六百餘人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizheng, Junzhou in Bianliang suffered a great flood; in Yangzhou Circuit, Chongming, Tong, Tai, and other prefectures the sea tide surged and overflowed, drowning more than sixteen hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhizheng, Junzhou in the Bianliang region was flooded; along Yangzhou Circuit, Chongming, Tong, Tai, and other prefectures the sea surged inland, drowning more than sixteen hundred people.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，睢州儀封縣大水害稼。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Yifeng County in Suizhou suffered a great flood that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, Yifeng County in Suizhou was flooded, destroying the harvest.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑夜，濟南山水暴漲，沖東西二關，流入小清河，黑山、天麻、石固等寨及臥龍山水通流入大清河，漂沒上下民居千餘家，溺死者無算。

translations.literal: On the night of the guichou day of the sixth month, mountain waters in Jinan rose violently, rushed through the eastern and western passes, flowed into the Xiaoqing River, and from Heishan, Tianma, Shigu, and other stockades and Wolong Mountain the waters joined and flowed into the Daqing River, sweeping away more than a thousand households up and down the river; the drowned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the guichou day in the sixth month, mountain torrents around Jinan burst forth, tore through the eastern and western passes into the Xiaoqing River, and from Heishan, Tianma, Shigu, and other stockades together with Wolong Mountain poured into the Daqing River, washing away more than a thousand homes along its course; the dead were beyond number.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，鞏昌寧遠、伏羌、成紀三縣山崩水湧，溺死者無算。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, in Ningyuan, Fuqiang, and Chengji counties in Gongchang, mountains collapsed and waters gushed forth; the drowned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year, mountains collapsed and floods erupted in Ningyuan, Fuqiang, and Chengji counties in Gongchang, and the dead were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 五月，黃河決白茅口。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Yellow River broke at Baimao Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Yellow River breached its banks at Baimao Mouth.

sentences.zh: 七月，汴梁中牟、扶溝、尉氏、洧川四縣，鄭州滎陽、汜水、河陰三縣大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Zhongmou, Fugou, Weishi, and Weichuan counties in Bianliang, and Xingyang, Sishui, and Heyin counties in Zhengzhou—all suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, great floods struck Zhongmou, Fugou, Weishi, and Weichuan counties in Bianliang, and Xingyang, Sishui, and Heyin counties in Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，霸州大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Bazhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Bazhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 六月，河南鞏縣大雨，伊、洛水溢，漂民居數百家。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Gong County in Henan had heavy rain; the Yi and Luo rivers overflowed and swept away several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, heavy rains at Gong County in Henan sent the Yi and Luo rivers over their banks, washing away several hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 濟寧路兗州，汴梁鄢陵、通許、陳留、臨潁等縣大水害稼，人相食。

translations.literal: Yanzhou in Jining Circuit, and Yanling, Tongxu, Chenliu, and Linying counties in Bianliang suffered great floods that damaged the crops; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou in Jining Circuit, together with Yanling, Tongxu, Chenliu, and Linying counties in Bianliang, were flooded and crops destroyed; people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 七月，灤河水溢，出平地丈餘，永平路禾稼廬舍漂沒甚眾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Luan River overflowed, standing more than a zhang above level ground; very many crops and dwellings in Yongping Circuit were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Luan River flooded to more than ten feet above the plain, sweeping away vast numbers of crops and homes throughout Yongping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 東平路東阿、陽谷、汶上、平陰四縣，衢州西安縣大水。

translations.literal: Dong'e, Yanggu, Wenshang, and Pingyin counties in Dongping Circuit, and Xi'an County in Quzhou, suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck Dong'e, Yanggu, Wenshang, and Pingyin counties in Dongping Circuit, and Xi'an County in Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 溫州颶風大作，海水溢，漂民居，溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: A great hurricane arose in Wenzhou; the sea overflowed, swept away dwellings, and very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: A violent hurricane struck Wenzhou; the sea surged inland, washing away homes and drowning a great many people.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，河決濟陰，漂官民亭舍殆盡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, seventh month, the Yellow River broke its banks at Jiyin, sweeping away nearly all official and private pavilions and lodges.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, the Yellow River breached its banks at Jiyin, destroying nearly every official and private building in its path.

sentences.zh: 十月，黃河泛溢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Yellow River flooded and overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, the Yellow River flooded widely.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，黃州大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year, Huangzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year, Huangzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，杭州、上海浦中午潮退而復至。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the eighth month, at Hangzhou and Shanghai Pu the noon tide receded and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eighth month, at Hangzhou and Shanghai Pu the midday tide ebbed and then surged back again.

sentences.zh: 八年正月辛亥，河決，陷濟寧路。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the first month of the eighth year, the Yellow River broke its banks and engulfed Jining Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the first month of the eighth year, the Yellow River burst its banks and inundated Jining Circuit.

sentences.zh: 四月，平江、松江大水。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Pingjiang and Songjiang suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Pingjiang and Songjiang were flooded.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，廣西山崩水湧，漓江溢，平地水深二丈餘，屋宇人畜漂沒。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the fifth month, mountains collapsed and waters gushed forth in Guangxi; the Li River overflowed; on level ground the water was more than two zhang deep; houses, people, and livestock were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the fifth month, landslides sent torrents through Guangxi; the Li River overflowed to more than twenty feet across the plain, carrying off homes, people, and livestock.

sentences.zh: 壬子，寶慶大水。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Baoxing suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Baoxing was inundated.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，錢塘江潮比之八月中高數丈餘，沿江民皆遷居以避之。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, the Qiantang River tide was several zhang higher than in the eighth month; people along the river all moved away to avoid it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the Qiantang bore ran several zhang higher than it had in the eighth month, and residents along the river relocated to escape it.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，中興路松滋縣驟雨，水暴漲，平地深丈有五尺餘，漂沒六十餘里，死者一千五百人。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the sixth month, Songzi County in Zhongxing Circuit had sudden rain; the water rose violently; on level ground the depth was one zhang and five chi; more than sixty li were inundated; fifteen hundred people died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the sixth month, a cloudburst at Songzi County in Zhongxing Circuit sent waters surging to fifteen feet across the plain, inundating more than sixty li of countryside and killing fifteen hundred people.

sentences.zh: 是月，膠州大水。

translations.literal: That month, Jiaozhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That same month, Jiaozhou was flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月，高密縣大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Gaomi County suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Gaomi County was inundated.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，中興路公安、石首、潛江、監利等縣及沔陽府大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year, Gong'an, Shishou, Qianjiang, Jianli, and other counties in Zhongxing Circuit, and Mianyang Prefecture, suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year, Gong'an, Shishou, Qianjiang, Jianli, and other counties in Zhongxing Circuit, together with Mianyang Prefecture, were devastated by flooding.

sentences.zh: 夏秋，蘄州大水傷稼。

translations.literal: In summer and autumn, Qizhou suffered a great flood that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Through summer and autumn, Qizhou was flooded, ruining the harvest.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，龍興瑞州大水。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year, Longxing and Ruizhou suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year, Longxing and Ruizhou were inundated.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，霍州靈石縣雨水暴漲，決堤堰，漂民居甚眾。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the sixth month, rainwaters at Lingshi County in Huozhou rose violently, broke the dikes, and swept away very many dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the sixth month, torrential rains at Lingshi County in Huozhou burst the dikes and washed away a great many homes.

sentences.zh: 七月，汾州平遙縣汾水溢，靜江荔浦縣大水害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Fen River overflowed in Pingyao County, Fenzhou; Lipu County in Jingjiang suffered a great flood that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Fen River flooded Pingyao County in Fenzhou, and Lipu County in Jingjiang was inundated, destroying the crops.

sentences.zh: 十一年夏，龍興南昌、新建二縣大水。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eleventh year, Nanchang and Xinjian counties in Longxing suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eleventh year, Nanchang and Xinjian counties in Longxing were flooded.

sentences.zh: 安慶桐城縣雨水泛漲，花崖、龍源二山崩，沖決縣東大河，漂民居四百餘家。

translations.literal: Tongcheng County in Anqing had rainwaters rise and flood; Huaya and Longyuan mountains collapsed, bursting through the great river east of the county seat, and sweeping away more than four hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At Tongcheng County in Anqing, rising floodwaters coincided with the collapse of Huaya and Longyuan mountains, which tore through the great river east of the county seat and washed away more than four hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 七月，冀寧路平晉、文水二縣大水，汾河泛溢東西兩岸，漂沒田禾數百頃。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Pingjin and Wenshui counties in Jining Circuit suffered great floods; the Fen River overflowed on both eastern and western banks, sweeping away several hundred qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Pingjin and Wenshui counties in Jining Circuit were inundated as the Fen River flooded both banks, destroying several hundred qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 河決歸德府永城縣，壞黃陵岡岸。

translations.literal: The river broke its banks at Yongcheng County, Guide Prefecture, destroying the banks of Huangling Mound.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached its banks at Yongcheng County in Guide Prefecture, destroying the embankments at Huangling Mound.

sentences.zh: 靜江路大水，決南北二陡渠。

translations.literal: Jingjiang Circuit suffered a great flood that burst the northern and southern steep canals.
translations.idiomatic: A great flood in Jingjiang Circuit burst both the northern and southern steep canals.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月，中興路松滋縣驟雨，水暴漲，漂民居千餘家，溺死七百人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year, Songzi County in Zhongxing Circuit had sudden rain; the water rose violently and swept away more than a thousand households; seven hundred people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twelfth year, a cloudburst at Songzi County in Zhongxing Circuit sent waters surging through the county, washing away more than a thousand homes and drowning seven hundred people.

sentences.zh: 七月，衢州西安縣大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Xi'an County in Quzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Xi'an County in Quzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 十三年夏，薊州豐潤、玉田、遵化、平谷四縣大水。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirteenth year, Fengrun, Yutian, Zunhua, and Pinggu—four counties in Jizhou—suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirteenth year, Fengrun, Yutian, Zunhua, and Pinggu—the four counties of Jizhou—were flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，泉州海水日三潮。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the seventh month, the sea at Quanzhou had three tides in a day.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the seventh month, the sea at Quanzhou rose three times in a single day.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月，河南府鞏縣大雨，伊、洛水溢，漂沒民居，溺死三百餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year, Gong County in Henan Prefecture had heavy rain; the Yi and Luo rivers overflowed, swept away dwellings, and more than three hundred people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year, heavy rains at Gong County in Henan Prefecture sent the Yi and Luo rivers over their banks, washing away homes and drowning more than three hundred people.

sentences.zh: 秋，薊州大水。

translations.literal: In autumn, Jizhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Jizhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 十五年六月，荊州大水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifteenth year, Jingzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifteenth year, Jingzhou was flooded.

sentences.zh: 十六年，河決鄭州河陰縣，官署民居盡廢，遂成中流。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the Yellow River broke its banks at Heyin County, Zhengzhou; government offices and dwellings were all destroyed, and it became midstream.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, the Yellow River breached its banks at Heyin County in Zhengzhou, obliterating government offices and homes until the river ran through where the town had stood.

sentences.zh: 山東大水。

translations.literal: Shandong suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong was devastated by flooding.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月，暑雨，漳河溢，廣平郡邑皆水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, summer rains caused the Zhang River to overflow; all prefectures and counties of Guangping were inundated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, summer rains sent the Zhang River over its banks, flooding every prefecture and county in Guangping.

sentences.zh: 秋，薊州四縣皆大水。

translations.literal: In autumn, all four counties of Jizhou suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, all four counties of Jizhou were inundated.

sentences.zh: 十八年秋，京師及薊州、廣東惠州、廣西四縣、賀州皆大水。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighteenth year, the capital, Jizhou, Huizhou in Guangdong, four counties in Guangxi, and Hezhou—all suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighteenth year, great floods struck the capital, Jizhou, Huizhou in Guangdong, four counties in Guangxi, and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 十九年九月，濟州任城縣河決。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the nineteenth year, the river broke its banks at Rencheng County, Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the nineteenth year, the river breached its banks at Rencheng County in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年七月，通州大水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twentieth year, Tongzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twentieth year, Tongzhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 二十二年三月，邵武光澤縣大水。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-second year, Guangze County in Shaowu suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-second year, Guangze County in Shaowu was flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，孟州濟源、溫縣水。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Jiyuan and Wen counties in Mengzhou were flooded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Jiyuan and Wen counties in Mengzhou were inundated.

sentences.zh: 七月，河決東平壽張縣，圮城墻，漂屋廬，人溺死甚眾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the Yellow River broke its banks at Shouzhang County, Dongping; the city wall collapsed; houses were swept away; very many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the Yellow River burst its banks at Shouzhang County in Dongping, collapsing the city wall, washing away buildings, and drowning a great many people.

sentences.zh: 二十四年三月，益都縣井水溢而黃。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year, the well water in Yidu County overflowed and turned yellow.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-fourth year, well water in Yidu County rose and turned yellow.

sentences.zh: 懷慶路孟州、河內、武陟縣水。

translations.literal: Mengzhou, Henei, and Wuzhi counties in Huaiqing Circuit were flooded.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzhou, Henei, and Wuzhi counties in Huaiqing Circuit were inundated.

sentences.zh: 七月，益都路壽光縣、膠州高密縣水。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Shouguang County in Yidu Circuit and Gaomi County in Jiaozhou were flooded.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Shouguang County in Yidu Circuit and Gaomi County in Jiaozhou were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十五年秋，薊州大水。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-fifth year, Jizhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-fifth year, Jizhou was inundated.

sentences.zh: 東平須城、東阿、平陰三縣河決小流口，達於清河，壞民居，傷禾稼。

translations.literal: In Xucheng, Dong'e, and Pingyin counties in Dongping, the river broke at Xiaoliukou and reached the Qing River, destroying dwellings and damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: At Xucheng, Dong'e, and Pingyin counties in Dongping, the river breached its banks at Xiaoliukou and poured into the Qing River, destroying homes and ruining the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，河北徙，上自東明、曹、濮，下及濟寧，皆被其害。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year, the Yellow River shifted course northward; from Dongming, Cao, and Pu above down to Jining below, all were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year, the Yellow River shifted northward; from Dongming, Cao, and Pu upstream down through Jining downstream, all regions along its course were devastated.

sentences.zh: 六月，河南府大霖雨，籞水溢，深四丈許，漂東關居民數百家。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the capital region of Henan Prefecture had great continuous rain; the Yu River overflowed to a depth of about four zhang, sweeping away several hundred households of the eastern ward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Henan Prefecture was deluged by torrential rains; the Yu River rose nearly forty feet deep, washing away several hundred homes in the eastern ward.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，汾州介休縣汾水溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, the Fen River overflowed in Jiexiu County, Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, the Fen River flooded Jiexiu County in Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 薊州四縣、衛輝、汴梁鈞州大水害稼。

translations.literal: The four counties of Jizhou, Weihui, and Junzhou in Bianliang suffered great floods that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: The four counties of Jizhou, Weihui, and Junzhou in the Bianliang region were flooded, destroying the harvest.

sentences.zh: 八月，棣州大清河決，濱、棣二州之界，民居漂流無遺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Daqing River broke its banks at Dizhou; on the border between Bin and Di prefectures, dwellings were swept away without a trace remaining.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Daqing River burst its banks at Dizhou; along the border of Bin and Di prefectures, every home in its path was washed away without a trace.

sentences.zh: 濟寧路肥城縣西黃水泛溢，漂沒田禾民居百有餘里，德州齊河縣境七十里亦如之。

translations.literal: The Huang River west of Feicheng County in Jining Circuit overflowed, sweeping away fields and dwellings for more than a hundred li; seventy li within Qihe County in Dezhou were likewise affected.
translations.idiomatic: West of Feicheng County in Jining Circuit, the Huang River flooded, destroying crops and homes across more than a hundred li; seventy li of Qihe County in Dezhou suffered the same fate.

sentences.zh: 至正二十年十一月，汴梁原武、滎澤二縣黃河清三日。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twentieth year of Zhizheng, the Yellow River ran clear for three days at Yuanwu and Xingze counties in Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twentieth year of Zhizheng, the Yellow River ran clear for three days at Yuanwu and Xingze counties in the Bianliang region.

sentences.zh: 二十一年十一月，河南孟津縣至絳州垣曲縣二百里河清七日，新安縣亦如之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twenty-first year, along two hundred li from Mengjin County in Henan to Yuanqu County in Jiangzhou, the river ran clear for seven days; Xin'an County was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twenty-first year, the river ran clear for seven days along two hundred li from Mengjin County in Henan to Yuanqu County in Jiangzhou; Xin'an County saw the same phenomenon.

sentences.zh: 十二月，冀寧路石州河水清，至明年春冰泮，始如故。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the river in Shizhou, Jining Circuit, ran clear; only when the ice melted the following spring did it return to normal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the river at Shizhou in Jining Circuit ran clear and did not return to its usual state until the ice melted the following spring.

sentences.zh: 二十四年夏，衛輝路黃河清。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-fourth year, the Yellow River in Weihui Circuit ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twenty-fourth year, the Yellow River ran clear through Weihui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 至正六年九月，彰德雨雪，結凍如琉璃。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Zhizheng, Zhangde had rain and snow that froze hard like glazed glass.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year of Zhizheng, rain and snow at Zhangde froze into a glaze as hard as glass.

sentences.zh: 七年八月，衛輝隕霜殺稼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year, Weihui had falling frost that killed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year, a killing frost at Weihui destroyed the standing crops.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，溫州大雪。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year, Wenzhou had heavy snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year, Wenzhou was buried in heavy snow.

sentences.zh: 十年春，彰德大寒，近清明節，雨雪三尺，民多凍餒而死。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year, Zhangde had severe cold; near the Qingming festival, rain and snow reached three chi; very many people died of cold and hunger.
translations.idiomatic: That spring at Zhangde, bitter cold near the Qingming festival brought three feet of rain and snow, and a great many people died of exposure and starvation.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月，汴梁路鈞州大雷雨雪，密縣平地雪深三尺餘。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year, Junzhou in Bianliang Circuit had great thunder, rain, and snow; on level ground in Mi County the snow was more than three chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eleventh year, Junzhou in Bianliang Circuit was struck by thunder, rain, and snow; in Mi County the snow lay more than three feet deep across the plain.

sentences.zh: 十三年秋，邵武光澤縣隕霜殺稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the thirteenth year, Guangze County in Shaowu had falling frost that killed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, a killing frost at Guangze County in Shaowu destroyed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十三年三月，東平路須城、東河、陽谷三縣隕霜殺桑，廢蠶事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-third year, Xucheng, Donghe, and Yanggu counties in Dongping Circuit had falling frost that killed the mulberry trees, and sericulture was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-third year, killing frost in Xucheng, Donghe, and Yanggu counties in Dongping Circuit destroyed the mulberry trees and brought sericulture to a halt.

sentences.zh: 八月，鈞州密縣隕霜殺菽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Mi County in Junzhou had falling frost that killed the beans.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a killing frost at Mi County in Junzhou destroyed the bean crop.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月，彰德大雪，寒甚於冬，民多凍死。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year, Zhangde had heavy snow, the cold exceeding winter; very many people froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year, heavy snow at Zhangde brought cold worse than midwinter, and a great many people froze to death.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，大同隕霜殺麥。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the fifth month, Datong had falling frost that killed the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the fifth month, a killing frost at Datong destroyed the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 秋，冀寧路徐溝、介休二縣雨雪。

translations.literal: In autumn, Xugou and Jiexiu counties in Jining Circuit had rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Xugou and Jiexiu counties in Jining Circuit were hit by rain and snow.

sentences.zh: 十二月，奉元路咸寧縣井水冰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the well water in Xianning County, Fengyuan Circuit, froze.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, well water in Xianning County, Fengyuan Circuit, turned to ice.

sentences.zh: 二十八年四月，奉元隕霜殺菽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-eighth year, Fengyuan had falling frost that killed the beans.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-eighth year, a killing frost at Fengyuan destroyed the bean crop.

sentences.zh: 元統元年三月戊子，紹興蕭山縣大風雨雹，拔木仆屋，殺麻麥，斃傷人民。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the third month of the first year of Yuantong, Xiaoshan County in Shaoxing had great wind, rain, and hail that uprooted trees and toppled houses, killed hemp and wheat, and struck down and injured people.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the third month of the first year of Yuantong, a violent storm of wind, rain, and hail at Xiaoshan County in Shaoxing uprooted trees, flattened houses, destroyed hemp and wheat, and killed or injured many people.

sentences.zh: 二年二月甲子，塞北東涼亭雨雹。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the second month of the second year, Dongliangting in the northern frontier had hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the second month of the second year, hail fell at Dongliangting on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 至元元年七月，西和州、徽州雨雹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhiyuan, Xihe Prefecture and Huizhou had hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhiyuan, hail fell at Xihe Prefecture and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 二年八月甲戌朔，高郵寶應縣大雨雹。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu new moon of the eighth month of the second year, Baoying County in Gaoyou had heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month of the second year, Baoying County in Gaoyou was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 是時，淮、浙皆旱，唯本縣瀕河，田禾可刈，悉為雹所害，凡田之旱者無一雹及之。

translations.literal: At that time Huai and Zhe were all in drought; only this county bordered the river and its fields could be harvested, yet all were harmed by hail; as for fields that were drought-stricken, not one was touched by hail.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Huai and Zhe regions were in drought; only this county, lying along the river, had crops ready to harvest, yet hail destroyed them all—while drought-stricken fields elsewhere escaped the hail entirely.

sentences.zh: 四年四月癸巳，清州八里塘雨雹，大過於拳，其狀有如龜者，有如小兒形者，有如獅象者，有如環玦者，或橢如卵，或圓如彈，玲瓏有竅，色白而堅，長老云：「大者固常見之，未有奇狀若是也。

translations.literal: On the siji day of the fourth month of the fourth year, Balitang in Qingzhou had hail larger than a fist; some were shaped like turtles, some like small children, some like lions and elephants, some like ring-disks; some were oval like eggs, some round like pellets, delicately pierced, white and hard. The elders said: "Large ones are indeed often seen, but never such strange shapes as these."
translations.idiomatic: On the siji day of the fourth month of the fourth year, hailstones larger than a fist fell at Balitang in Qingzhou—some shaped like turtles, children, lions and elephants, or ring-disks; some oval as eggs, others round as pellets, white, hard, and intricately hollowed. The elders remarked, "We have often seen large hail, but never shapes as strange as these."

sentences.zh: 」至正二年五月，東平路東阿縣雨雹，大者如馬首。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhizheng, Dong'e County in Dongping Circuit had hail; the largest were like a horse's head.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhizheng, hail fell at Dong'e County in Dongping Circuit; the largest stones were the size of a horse's head.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，東平陽谷縣雨雹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, Yanggu County in Dongping had hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, hail fell at Yanggu County in Dongping.

sentences.zh: 六年二月辛未，興國路雨雹，大如馬首，小者如雞子，斃禽畜甚眾。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the second month of the sixth year, Xingguo Circuit had hail as large as a horse's head and as small as chicken eggs; very many birds and livestock were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the second month of the sixth year, hailstones as large as horses' heads and as small as eggs fell on Xingguo Circuit, killing a great many birds and livestock.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，絳州雨雹，大者二尺餘。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day of the fifth month, Jiangzhou had hail; the largest were more than two chi.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fifth month, hail fell at Jiangzhou; the largest stones measured more than two feet across.

sentences.zh: 八年四月庚辰，鈞州密縣雨雹，大如雞子，傷麥禾。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day of the fourth month of the eighth year, Mi County in Junzhou had hail as large as chicken eggs, damaging wheat and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the fourth month of the eighth year, egg-sized hail at Mi County in Junzhou damaged the wheat and grain crops.

sentences.zh: 龍興奉新縣大雨雹，傷禾折木。

translations.literal: Fengxin County in Longxing had heavy hail that damaged grain and broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy hail at Fengxin County in Longxing damaged crops and snapped trees.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，益都臨淄縣雨雹，大如杯盂，野無青草，赤地如赭。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the eighth month, Linzi County in Yidu had hail as large as cups and bowls; in the wild there was no green grass; the bare ground was like ochre.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the eighth month, hailstones the size of cups and bowls fell on Linzi County in Yidu, stripping the countryside of every blade of grass until the earth lay bare and red as ochre.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，龍興大雨雹。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year, Longxing had heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the ninth year, Longxing was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，汾州平遙縣雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year, Pingyao County in Fenzhou had hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the tenth year, hail fell at Pingyao County in Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月乙巳，彰德雨雹，大者如斧，時麥熟將刈，頃刻亡失，田疇堅如築場，無稭粒遺留者，地廣三十里，長百有餘里，樹木皆如斧所劈，傷行人、斃禽畜甚眾。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the fourth month of the eleventh year, Zhangde had hail as large as axes; at the time the wheat was ripe and about to be harvested, yet in an instant it was all lost; the fields were as hard as a threshing floor with not a stalk remaining; the area was thirty li wide and more than a hundred li long; trees were all as if split by axes; travelers were injured and very many birds and livestock were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fourth month of the eleventh year, axe-sized hailstones struck Zhangde just as the wheat stood ready for harvest, destroying it in an instant. Fields across thirty li in width and more than a hundred li in length were beaten flat as threshing floors, stripped of every stalk; trees looked as though cleaved by axes; travelers were injured and countless birds and livestock were killed.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，文水縣雨雹。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the fifth month, Wenshui County had hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the fifth month, hail fell at Wenshui County.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月，益都高苑縣雨雹，傷麥禾及桑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year, Gaoyuan County in Yidu had hail that damaged wheat, grain, and mulberry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year, hail at Gaoyuan County in Yidu damaged wheat, grain, and mulberry trees.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月，薊州雨雹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year, Jizhou had hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourteenth year, hail fell at Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年四月，濟南大風雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventeenth year, Jinan had great wind, rain, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventeenth year, Jinan was struck by violent wind, rain, and hail.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月，莒州蒙陰縣雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year, Mengyin County in Juzhou had hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year, hail fell at Mengyin County in Juzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，通州及益都臨朐縣雨雹害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Tongzhou and Linqu County in Yidu had hail that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, hail at Tongzhou and Linqu County in Yidu destroyed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十年五月，薊州遵化縣雨雹終日。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twentieth year, Zunhua County in Jizhou had hail all day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twentieth year, hail fell on Zunhua County in Jizhou throughout the day.

sentences.zh: 二十一年五月，東平雨雹害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-first year, Dongping had hail that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-first year, hail at Dongping destroyed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十二年八月，南雄雨雹如桃李實。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-second year, Nanxiong had hail like peach and plum fruits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-second year, hailstones the size of peaches and plums fell on Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月，鄜州宜君縣雨雹，大如雞子，損豆麥。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, Yijun County in Fuzhou had hail as large as chicken eggs, damaging beans and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, egg-sized hail at Yijun County in Fuzhou damaged the bean and wheat crops.

sentences.zh: 七月，京師及隰州永和縣大雨雹害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the capital and Yonghe County in Xizhou had heavy hail that damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, heavy hail at the capital and Yonghe County in Xizhou destroyed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十五年五月，東昌聊城縣雨雹，大如拳，小者如雞子，二麥不登。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year, Liaocheng County in Dongchang had hail as large as a fist and as small as chicken eggs; the two grains failed to ripen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year, fist-sized hailstones and smaller egg-sized ones fell on Liaocheng County in Dongchang, and both wheat crops failed.

sentences.zh: 二十六年六月，汾州平遙縣雨雹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-sixth year, Pingyao County in Fenzhou had hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-sixth year, hail fell at Pingyao County in Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十七年二月乙丑，永州城中晝晦，雞棲於塒，人舉燈而食，既而大雨雹，逾時方明。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the second month of the twenty-seventh year, within Yongzhou city it was dark at midday; chickens roosted in their coops; people lit lamps to eat; then there was heavy hail; only after some time did it become light.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the second month of the twenty-seventh year, Yongzhou city was plunged into midday darkness; chickens returned to their roosts and people ate by lamplight before a violent hailstorm struck; daylight did not return for some time.

sentences.zh: 五月，益都大雷雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Yidu had great thunder, rain, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yidu was struck by violent thunder, rain, and hail.

sentences.zh: 七月，冀寧徐溝縣大風雨雹，拔木害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Xugou County in Jining had great wind, rain, and hail that uprooted trees and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a storm of wind, rain, and hail at Xugou County in Jining uprooted trees and destroyed the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十八年六月，慶陽府雨雹，大如盂，小者如彈丸，平地厚尺餘，殺苗稼，斃禽獸。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, Qingyang Prefecture had hail as large as bowls and as small as pellets; on level ground it lay more than a chi thick, killing seedlings and crops and striking down birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, hailstones as large as bowls and as small as pellets covered Qingyang Prefecture to a depth of more than a foot on level ground, destroying crops and killing birds and beasts.

sentences.zh: 至正三年秋，興國路永興縣雷，擊死糧房貼書尹章於縣治。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year of Zhizheng, Yongxing County in Xingguo Circuit was struck by lightning that killed Yin Zhang, the grain-office clerk, at the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the third year of Zhizheng, lightning at Yongxing County in Xingguo Circuit struck and killed Yin Zhang, clerk of the grain office, at the county yamen.

sentences.zh: 時方大旱，有朱書在其背云：「有旱卻言無旱，無災卻道有災，未庸殲厥渠魁，且擊庭前小吏。

translations.literal: At the time there was severe drought; on his back there was writing in cinnabar that said: "There is drought yet you say there is none; there is no disaster yet you say there is—since you have not yet destroyed the ringleaders, for now strike the petty clerk in the courtyard."
translations.idiomatic: The region was in severe drought at the time. On his back appeared writing in red: "You claim there is no drought when there is drought; you speak of disaster where there is none—since the chief culprits have not yet been destroyed, for now strike down the petty clerk in the courtyard."

sentences.zh: 」七年五月庚戌，臺州路黃巖州海濱無雲而雷。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the fifth month of the seventh year, along the seashore at Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Circuit there was thunder without clouds.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the fifth month of the seventh year, thunder rolled along the seashore at Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Circuit though no clouds were in sight.

sentences.zh: 冬，衛輝路天鼓鳴。

translations.literal: In winter, the sky drum sounded in Weihui Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, the sky drum resounded over Weihui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十年六月戊申，廣西臨桂縣無雲而雷，震死邑民廖黃達。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the sixth month of the tenth year, Lingui County in Guangxi had thunder without clouds that struck and killed the townsman Liao Huangda.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the sixth month of the tenth year, thunder without clouds at Lingui County in Guangxi struck and killed the local resident Liao Huangda.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，汾州孝義縣雷雨。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the twelfth month, Xiaoyi County in Fenzhou had thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the twelfth month, thunder and rain struck Xiaoyi County in Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年十二月，臺州大雨震電。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year, Taizhou had heavy rain, thunder, and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year, Taizhou was lashed by heavy rain, thunder, and lightning.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月丙午，寧國路無雲而雷。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the third month of the twelfth year, Ningguo Circuit had thunder without clouds.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the third month of the twelfth year, thunder rolled over Ningguo Circuit though no clouds were visible.

sentences.zh: 十三年十二月庚戌，京師無雲而雷，少頃有火墜於東南。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month of the thirteenth year, the capital had thunder without clouds; shortly afterward fire fell in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month of the thirteenth year, thunder without clouds shook the capital, and shortly afterward a fireball fell in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 懷慶路河內縣及河南府天鼓鳴於西北。

translations.literal: The sky drum sounded in the northwest at Henei County in Huaiqing Circuit and at Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The sky drum resounded from the northwest over Henei County in Huaiqing Circuit and Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是日懷慶之修武、潞州之襄垣縣皆無雲而雷，聲震天地。

translations.literal: That day Xiushui in Huaiqing and Xiangyuan County in Luzhou all had thunder without clouds, the sound shaking heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, Xiushui in Huaiqing and Xiangyuan County in Luzhou were shaken by thunder without clouds, the sound reverberating across heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 是月，汾州雷雨。

translations.literal: That month, Fenzhou had thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: That month, thunder and rain struck Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年十二月，孝義縣雷雨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourteenth year, Xiaoyi County had thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourteenth year, thunder and rain struck Xiaoyi County.

sentences.zh: 十九年十二月，臺州大雷電。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the nineteenth year, Taizhou had great thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the nineteenth year, Taizhou was shaken by violent thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 二十一年十一月戊申，溫州樂清縣雷。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the eleventh month of the twenty-first year, Yueqing County in Wenzhou had thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the eleventh month of the twenty-first year, thunder rolled over Yueqing County in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十七年正月乙未夜，晉寧路絳州天鼓鳴空中，如聞戰鬥之聲。

translations.literal: On the night of the yiwei day of the first month of the twenty-seventh year, the sky drum sounded in the air at Jiangzhou in Jinning Circuit, like the sound of battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the yiwei day of the first month of the twenty-seventh year, the sky drum resounded over Jiangzhou in Jinning Circuit like the clash of armies.

sentences.zh: 十月，奉元路雷電。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Fengyuan Circuit had thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, thunder and lightning struck Fengyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 至正二十五年六月戊申，京師大雨，有魚隨雨而落，長尺許，人取而食之。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the sixth month of the twenty-fifth year of Zhizheng, the capital had heavy rain; fish fell with the rain, about a chi long, and people took them and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the sixth month of the twenty-fifth year of Zhizheng, heavy rain at the capital brought fish falling from the sky, each about a foot long, which people gathered and ate.

sentences.zh: 至元五年六月庚戌，汀州長汀縣山蛟出，大雨驟至，平地湧水，深三丈餘，漂沒民居八百餘家，壞田二百餘頃。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the sixth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, a mountain flood-dragon emerged at Changting County in Tingzhou; sudden heavy rain came; water gushed up on level ground to a depth of more than three zhang; more than eight hundred households were swept away; more than two hundred qing of fields were ruined.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, a mountain flood-dragon appeared at Changting County in Tingzhou, and a sudden deluge sent waters surging thirty feet across the plain, washing away more than eight hundred homes and ruining more than two hundred qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 至正十七年六月癸酉，溫州有龍鬥於樂清江中，颶風大作，所至有光如球，死者萬餘人。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the sixth month of the seventeenth year of Zhizheng, at Wenzhou dragons fought in the Yueqing River; a great hurricane arose; wherever they went there was light like a ball; more than ten thousand people died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the sixth month of the seventeenth year of Zhizheng, dragons were seen battling in the Yueqing River at Wenzhou as a violent hurricane swept through, leaving glowing spheres in its wake and killing more than ten thousand people.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，祥符縣西北有青白二龍見，若相鬥之勢，良久而散。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the eighth month, northwest of Xiangfu County blue and white dragons appeared, as if in mutual combat, and only after a long while did they disperse.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the eighth month, blue and white dragons appeared northwest of Xiangfu County, seeming to battle one another before finally dispersing.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月甲辰，廣西貴州江中有物登岸，蛇首四足而青色，長四尺許，軍民聚觀而殺之。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the first month of the twenty-third year, in the river at Guizhou in Guangxi a creature came ashore with a serpent's head and four legs, blue-green in color, about four chi long; soldiers and civilians gathered to watch and killed it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the first month of the twenty-third year, a creature with a serpent's head, four legs, and blue-green scales about four feet long climbed ashore from the river at Guizhou in Guangxi; soldiers and civilians gathered to watch and killed it.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月，保德州有黃龍見於咸寧井中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year, at Baode Prefecture a yellow dragon was seen in the Xianning well.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year, a yellow dragon was sighted in the Xianning well at Baode Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十七年六月丁巳，皇太子寢殿新甃井成，有龍自井而出，光焰爍人，宮人震懾仆地。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year, when the newly lined well in the crown prince's sleeping hall was completed, a dragon emerged from the well; its radiance dazzled people; palace women were shaken with fear and fell to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year, as a newly finished well in the crown prince's sleeping quarters was completed, a dragon burst forth blinding those nearby and sending palace women fleeing in terror to the ground.

sentences.zh: 又宮墻外長慶寺所掌成宗斡耳朵內大槐樹，有龍纏繞其上，良久飛去，樹皮皆剝。

translations.literal: Moreover, on the great locust tree within the ordo of Emperor Chengzong administered by Changqing Temple outside the palace wall, a dragon coiled around it; after a long while it flew away, and all the bark was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile, on the great locust tree in the ordo of Emperor Chengzong managed by Changqing Temple beyond the palace wall, a dragon coiled around the trunk before flying away after some time, stripping the bark entirely.

sentences.zh: 七月，益都臨朐縣有龍見於龍山，巨石重千斤，浮空而起。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, at Linqu County in Yidu a dragon was seen on Dragon Mountain; a great stone weighing a thousand jin rose into the air.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a dragon was sighted on Dragon Mountain at Linqu County in Yidu, and a boulder weighing a thousand jin rose into the air.

sentences.zh: 二十八年十一月，大同路懷仁縣河岸崩，有蛇大小相綰結，可載數車。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twenty-eighth year, the riverbank collapsed at Huairen County in Datong Circuit; serpents large and small were intertwined, enough to fill several carts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twenty-eighth year, a riverbank collapse at Huairen County in Datong Circuit exposed serpents large and small twisted together in a mass that would have filled several carts.

sentences.zh: 至正三年秋，建寧浦城縣民家豕生豚，二尾八足。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year of Zhizheng, at a commoner's home in Pucheng County, Jianning, a sow gave birth to a piglet with two tails and eight legs.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the third year of Zhizheng, a sow at a household in Pucheng County, Jianning, farrowed a piglet with two tails and eight legs.

sentences.zh: 十五年，鎮江民家豕生豚如象形。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, at a commoner's home in Zhenjiang a sow gave birth to a piglet shaped like an elephant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, a sow at a household in Zhenjiang farrowed a piglet shaped like an elephant.

sentences.zh: 二十四年正月，保德州民家豕生豚，一首二身八蹄二尾。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, at a commoner's home in Baode Prefecture a sow gave birth to a piglet with one head, two bodies, eight hooves, and two tails.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year, a sow at a household in Baode Prefecture farrowed a piglet with one head, two bodies, eight hooves, and two tails.

sentences.zh: 至元元年正月，廣西師宗州軿生妻適和，一產三男。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Zhiyuan, the wife of a cart-driver named Shihe in Shizong Prefecture, Guangxi, gave birth to three sons at one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Zhiyuan, the wife of a cart-driver named Shihe in Shizong Prefecture, Guangxi, gave birth to triplet sons.

sentences.zh: 汴梁祥符縣市中一乞丐婦人，忽生髭須。

translations.literal: In the market of Xiangfu County, Bianliang, a beggar woman suddenly grew a beard and mustache.
translations.idiomatic: In the marketplace of Xiangfu County in the Bianliang region, a female beggar suddenly sprouted a beard and mustache.

sentences.zh: 至正九年四月，棗陽民張氏婦生男，甫及周歲，長四尺許，容貌異常，皤腹擁腫，見人輒嬉笑，如世俗所畫布袋和尚云。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the ninth year of Zhizheng, the wife of Zhang, a commoner of Zaoyang, gave birth to a son; when he had just reached one year, he was about four chi tall, his appearance extraordinary, his belly white and swollen; whenever he saw people he would laugh and smile, like the Cloth-Bag Monk as painted in the world.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the ninth year of Zhizheng, the wife of Zhang, a commoner of Zaoyang, bore a son who by his first birthday stood four feet tall with an extraordinary appearance, a pale swollen belly, and a habit of laughing whenever he saw anyone—just like the Cloth-Bag Monk of popular paintings.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月，霸州民王馬駒妻趙氏，一產三男。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, Zhao, wife of Wang Maju, a commoner of Bazhou, gave birth to three sons at one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, Zhao, wife of Wang Maju, a commoner of Bazhou, gave birth to triplet sons.

sentences.zh: 六月，毫家務李閏妻張氏，一產三男。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Zhang, wife of Li Run of Haojiawu, gave birth to three sons at one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Zhang, wife of Li Run of Haojiawu, gave birth to triplet sons.

sentences.zh: 至正元年四月戊寅，彰德有赤風自西北來，忽變為黑，晝晦如夜。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day of the fourth month of the first year of Zhizheng, Zhangde had a red wind come from the northwest that suddenly turned black; daytime was dark like night.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fourth month of the first year of Zhizheng, a red wind from the northwest swept over Zhangde and suddenly turned black, plunging the day into darkness like night.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，袁州路每日暮，有黑氣環繞郡城。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year, Yuanzhou Circuit each day at dusk had black vapors encircling the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: That winter in the thirteenth year, black vapors encircled the prefectural seat of Yuanzhou Circuit each evening at dusk.

sentences.zh: 十七年正月己丑，杭州降黑雨，河池水皆黑。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the first month of the seventeenth year, Hangzhou had black rain fall; river and pond waters all turned black.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the first month of the seventeenth year, black rain fell on Hangzhou, turning every river and pond black.

sentences.zh: 二十八年七月乙亥，京師黑霧，昏暝不辨人物，自旦近午始消，如是者旬有五日。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the seventh month of the twenty-eighth year, the capital had black fog; it was dim and dark and people could not be distinguished; from dawn until near noon it only then dispersed; it was thus for fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the seventh month of the twenty-eighth year, black fog enveloped the capital in a gloom so thick that people could not be distinguished; each day it lingered from dawn until nearly noon, and this continued for fifteen days.

sentences.zh: 火不炎上

translations.literal: Fire fails to blaze upward
translations.idiomatic: Fire fails to blaze and rise upward

sentences.zh: 元統元年六月甲申，杭州火。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the sixth month of the first year of Yuantong, Hangzhou had fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the sixth month of the first year of Yuantong, fire broke out in Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 至正元年四月辛卯，臺州火。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day of the fourth month of the first year of Zhizheng, Taizhou had fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fourth month of the first year of Zhizheng, fire broke out in Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，杭州火，燔官舍民居公廨寺觀，凡一萬五千七百餘間，死者七十有四人。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, Hangzhou had fire that burned government lodgings, common dwellings, public offices, temples, and shrines—more than fifteen thousand seven hundred rooms in all; seventy-four people died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, fire swept Hangzhou, destroying more than fifteen thousand seven hundred government buildings, homes, offices, temples, and shrines, and killing seventy-four people.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，杭州又火。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Hangzhou had fire again.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year, fire broke out in Hangzhou again.

sentences.zh: 六年八月己巳，延平路火，燔官舍民居八百餘區，死者五人。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the eighth month of the sixth year, Yanping Circuit had fire that burned more than eight hundred government lodgings and common dwellings; five people died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the eighth month of the sixth year, fire in Yanping Circuit destroyed more than eight hundred government and private buildings, killing five people.

sentences.zh: 十年，興國路自春及夏，城中火災不絕，日數十起。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Xingguo Circuit from spring through summer had fires in the city without cease, several tens each day.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the tenth year, from spring into summer, Xingguo Circuit saw fires in the city without cease—dozens breaking out each day.

sentences.zh: 二十年，惠州路城中火災屢見。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Huizhou Circuit frequently had fires in the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, fires repeatedly broke out in the city of Huizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月乙卯夜，廣西貴州火，同知州事韓帖木不花、判官高萬章及家人九口俱死焉，居民死者三百餘人，牛五十頭，馬九匹，公署、倉庫、案牘焚燒皆盡。

translations.literal: On the night of the yimao day of the first month of the twenty-third year, Guizhou in Guangxi had fire; Vice Prefect Han Temurbuhua, Judge Gao Wanzhang, and nine members of their families all died; among the residents more than three hundred died; fifty oxen and nine horses; government offices, storehouses, and documents were all burned completely.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the yimao day of the first month of the twenty-third year, fire devastated Guizhou in Guangxi, killing Vice Prefect Han Temurbuhua, Judge Gao Wanzhang, and nine members of their households, along with more than three hundred residents, fifty oxen, and nine horses; government offices, storehouses, and all records were burned to ashes.

sentences.zh: 二十八年二月癸卯，京師武器庫災。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-eighth year, on the guimao day, the capital's weapons depot suffered a disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the second month of the twenty-eighth year, fire destroyed the weapons depot at the capital.

sentences.zh: 己巳，陜西有飛火自華山下，流入張良弼營中，焚兵庫器仗。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, in Shaanxi flying fire came down from beneath Mount Hua, flowed into Zhang Liangbi's camp, and burned the armory weapons and gear.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, a ball of flying fire descended from Mount Hua in Shaanxi, swept into Zhang Liangbi's camp, and burned the arsenal's weapons and equipment.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，大都大聖壽萬安寺災。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the jiayin day, the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple in Dadu suffered a disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the sixth month, fire consumed the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple in Dadu.

sentences.zh: 是日未時，雷雨中有火自空而下，其殿脊東鰲魚口火焰出，佛身上亦火起。

translations.literal: That day at the wei hour, amid thunder and rain fire came down from the sky; from the mouth of the dragon-fish finial on the eastern ridge of the hall flames issued forth, and fire also rose upon the Buddha's body.
translations.idiomatic: That afternoon, as thunder and rain fell, fire descended from the sky—from the mouth of the dragon-fish ornament on the hall's eastern roof-ridge flames burst forth, and the Buddha image itself caught fire.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之泣下，亟命百官救護，唯東西二影堂神主及寶玩器物得免，餘皆焚毀。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he wept; he urgently ordered the hundred officials to rescue and protect it, but only the spirit tablets of the eastern and western memorial halls and precious curios and vessels were spared—all else was burned and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wept when he heard the news and urgently ordered officials to the scene; only the spirit tablets in the eastern and western memorial halls and a few precious objects were saved—everything else was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 此寺舊名白塔，自世祖以來，為百官習儀之所，其殿陛闌楯一如內庭之制。

translations.literal: This temple was formerly called White Pagoda; since the time of the Founding Emperor it had been the place where the hundred officials practiced court ritual; its hall steps and balustrades were exactly like those of the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: The temple had formerly been known as White Pagoda; since Kublai's reign it had served as the place where officials rehearsed court ceremony, and its hall steps and railings were laid out just like those of the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 成宗時，置世祖影堂於殿之西，裕宗影堂於殿之東，月遣大臣致祭。

translations.literal: In the time of Chengzong, Kublai's memorial hall was placed on the west of the hall and that of Prince Yuzong on the east; each month a great minister was sent to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chengzong, Kublai's memorial hall was installed west of the main hall and Prince Yuzong's to the east; each month a senior minister was dispatched to offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 至元六年冬，京師無雪。

translations.literal: In the winter of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, the capital had no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter in the sixth year of Zhiyuan, no snow fell on the capital.

sentences.zh: 至正八年九月，奉元路桃杏花。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year of Zhizheng, Fengyuan Circuit had peach and apricot blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eighth year of Zhizheng, peach and apricot trees bloomed out of season in Fengyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月，冀寧路榆次縣桃李花。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, Yuci County in Jining Circuit had peach and plum blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, peach and plum trees blossomed in Yuci County, Jining Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十五年十一月，汾州介休縣桃杏花。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifteenth year, Jiexiu County in Fen Prefecture had peach and apricot blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifteenth year, peach and apricot trees bloomed in Jiexiu County, Fen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十七年十一月，汾州桃杏花。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventeenth year, Fen Prefecture had peach and apricot blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the seventeenth year, peach and apricot trees bloomed in Fen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至正十一年十月，衢州東北雨米如黍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Zhizheng, northeast of Quzhou rain fell of grain like millet.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Zhizheng, grain resembling millet rained down northeast of Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月，建寧浦城縣雨黑子如稗實；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Pucheng County in Jianning had rain of black seeds like barnyard-millet kernels;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, black seeds the size of barnyard-millet grains fell like rain on Pucheng County in Jianning;

sentences.zh: 邵武大雨震電，雨黑黍如蘆穄，信州雨黑黍；

translations.literal: Shaowu had heavy rain, thunder, and lightning, with rain of black grain like reed millet; Xin Prefecture had rain of black grain;
translations.idiomatic: At Shaowu, a thunderstorm brought black grain like reed millet; Xin Prefecture also saw black grain fall from the sky;

sentences.zh: 鄱陽縣雨菽豆。

translations.literal: Poyang County had rain of beans and soybeans.
translations.idiomatic: Beans and soybeans rained down on Poyang County.

sentences.zh: 郡邑多有，民皆取而食之。

translations.literal: Many commanderies and counties had this; the people all took them and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: The phenomenon appeared in many districts, and people everywhere gathered the fallen grain and ate it.

sentences.zh: 十六年六月，彰德路葦葉順次倚疊而生，自編成若旗幟，上尖葉聚粘如槍，民謠云：「葦生成旗，民皆流離；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixteenth year, in Zhangde Circuit reed leaves grew one upon another in sequence, themselves weaving together like banners and flags; pointed leaves at the top clustered and stuck together like spears. A folk rhyme said: "When reeds form flags, the people all are driven from home;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixteenth year at Zhangde Circuit, reed leaves stacked up layer by layer until they wove themselves into banner-like shapes, with pointed leaves at the top clumping together like spearheads. A folk rhyme ran: "When reeds turn to flags, the people flee their homes;

sentences.zh: 葦生成槍，殺伐遭殃。

translations.literal: When reeds form spears, slaughter and suffering follow.
translations.idiomatic: When reeds turn to spears, war and slaughter bring disaster.

sentences.zh: 」又有黍自生成文，紅稭黑字，其上節云「天下太平」，其下節云「天下刀兵」。

translations.literal: There were also millet stalks on which writing formed by itself, with red stalks and black characters; the upper joint said "All-under-Heaven at peace," and the lower joint said "All-under-Heaven at war with blades."
translations.idiomatic: There were also millet stalks on which characters appeared spontaneously—red stalks bearing black writing—with the upper node reading "Peace under Heaven" and the lower node reading "War under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 十八年，處州山谷中小竹結實如小麥，饑民采食之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, in the valleys of Chuzhou small bamboo bore fruit like wheat; hungry people gathered and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, dwarf bamboo in the valleys of Chuzhou produced grain-like fruit, which hungry people gathered and ate.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，明州象山縣竹穗生實如小米，可食。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, in Xiangshan County, Ming Prefecture, bamboo seed-heads bore fruit like millet, which could be eaten.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, bamboo seed heads in Xiangshan County, Ming Prefecture, produced edible grain resembling millet.

sentences.zh: 至正十一年，廣西慶遠府有異禽雙飛，見於述昆鄉，飛鳥千百隨之，蓋鳳凰云。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhizheng, at Qingyuan Prefecture in Guangxi an extraordinary pair of birds flew together; they were seen at Shukun Township, and a thousand or hundred flying birds followed them—it was said to be the phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Zhizheng, a pair of strange birds flew together over Qingyuan Prefecture in Guangxi; sighted at Shukun Township with hundreds of other birds trailing behind, they were taken to be phoenixes.

sentences.zh: 其一飛去，其一留止者，為僮人射死，首長尺許，毛羽五色，有藏之以獻於帥府者，久而其色鮮明如生云。

translations.literal: One flew away; the one that remained was shot dead by a Zhuang tribesman; its head was about a chi long, its feathers five-colored; someone preserved it and presented it to the commander's office, and after a long time its colors remained as bright as in life, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: One of the pair flew off; the other lingered and was shot dead by a Zhuang hunter. Its head measured about a foot long and its plumage was five-colored; someone preserved the carcass and presented it to the military command, and long afterward its colors remained as vivid as in life.

sentences.zh: 五月，興國有大鳥百餘，飛至郡西白朗山顛，狀如人立，去而復至者數次。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, at Xingguo more than a hundred great birds flew to the summit of Bailang Mountain west of the prefecture; their form was like a person standing; they left and returned again several times.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, more than a hundred large birds flew to the summit of Bailang Mountain west of Xingguo Prefecture, standing upright like human figures; they departed and returned several times.

sentences.zh: 十九年，京師鴟鸮夜鳴達旦，連月乃止，有杜鵑啼於城中，居庸關亦如之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, at the capital owls and horned owls cried through the night until dawn; this continued for months before stopping; cuckoos called within the city, and Juyong Pass was the same.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, owls and horned owls at the capital hooted all night until dawn for months on end; cuckoos were heard calling in the city, and the same occurred at Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月丁丑朔，萊州招遠縣大社裏黑風大起，有大鳥自南飛至，其色蒼白，展翅如席，狀類鶴，俄頃飛去，遺下粟、黍、稻、麥、黃黑豆、蕎麥於張家屋上，約數升許，是歲大稔。

translations.literal: On the dingchou new moon of the third month of the twenty-seventh year, in Dashe Village, Zhaoyuan County, Laizhou, a black wind rose violently; a great bird flew in from the south, its color pale blue and white, its wings spread like a mat, its form resembling a crane; in a moment it flew away, leaving behind millet, glutinous millet, rice, wheat, yellow and black beans, and buckwheat on the roof of the Zhang family's house—about several sheng in amount; that year had a great harvest.
