translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month of the twenty-seventh year at Dashe Village in Zhaoyuan County, Laizhou, a black gale erupted; a huge pale bird flew in from the south with wings spanning a mat's width, looking like a crane. It soon departed, scattering several pints of millet, glutinous millet, rice, wheat, yellow and black beans, and buckwheat onto the Zhang family's roof—a year of bountiful harvest followed.

sentences.zh: 元統二年正月庚寅朔，河南省雨血。

translations.literal: On the gengyin new moon of the first month of the second year of Yuantong, Henan Province had rain of blood.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of the second year of Yuantong, blood-red rain fell over Henan Province.

sentences.zh: 是日眾官晨集，忽聞燔柴煙氣，既而黑霧四塞，咫尺不辨，腥穢逼人，逾時方息。

translations.literal: That day the assembled officials gathered in the morning; suddenly they smelled the smoke of burnt sacrificial wood; then black mist filled all sides, and at arm's length one could not distinguish anything; a foul bloody stench pressed upon people, and only after some time did it abate.
translations.idiomatic: That morning, as officials assembled, they suddenly caught the scent of sacrificial smoke; black fog then closed in on every side so that one could see nothing an arm's length away, and a rank bloody odor filled the air before subsiding after some time.

sentences.zh: 及行禮畢，日過午，驟雨隨至，沾灑堊墻及裳衣皆赤。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed and the sun had passed noon, sudden rain followed; what it spattered upon—whitewashed walls and robe and garment—all turned red.
translations.idiomatic: After the ceremonies concluded and the sun passed midday, a sudden rain fell, staining whitewashed walls and everyone's clothing red.

sentences.zh: 至元四年四月辛未，京師雨紅沙，晝晦。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the fourth month of the fourth year of Zhiyuan, the capital had rain of red sand; day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fourth month of the fourth year of Zhiyuan, red sand rained over the capital and daylight grew dim.

sentences.zh: 至正五年四月，鎮江丹陽縣雨紅霧，草木葉及行人裳衣皆濡成紅色。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year of Zhizheng, Danyang County in Zhenjiang had rain of red mist; the leaves of grass and trees and travelers' robes and garments all became soaked and turned red.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year of Zhizheng, red mist rained on Danyang County in Zhenjiang, turning the leaves of trees and grass and the clothing of passersby red.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月丙戌，彰德路西南，有火自天而下，如在城外，覓之無有。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the third month of the thirteenth year, southwest of Zhangde Circuit, fire came down from heaven; it seemed to be outside the city wall, but when they searched for it there was nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the third month of the thirteenth year, fire appeared to fall from the sky southwest of Zhangde Circuit, seemingly beyond the city walls—but searchers found nothing there.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，潞州襄垣縣有火墜於東南。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month, Xiangyuan County in Lu Prefecture had fire fall in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month, a fireball fell in the southeast of Xiangyuan County, Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十四年，衛輝路有天光見於西方。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Weihui Circuit had celestial light appear in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, a celestial light appeared in the western sky over Weihui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，絳州有紅氣，起自北方，蔽天幾半，移時方散。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day of the twelfth month, Jiang Prefecture had red vapor rising from the north, veiling half the sky; only after some time did it disperse.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the twelfth month, red vapor rose from the north over Jiang Prefecture, shrouding nearly half the sky before dispersing after some time.

sentences.zh: 十五年春，薊州雨血。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year, Jizhou had rain of blood.
translations.idiomatic: That spring in the fifteenth year, blood-red rain fell on Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年三月辛丑夜，大同路有黑氣蔽於西方，聲如雷然。

translations.literal: On the night of the xinchou day of the third month of the eighteenth year, Datong Circuit had black vapor veiling the west, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the xinchou day of the third month of the eighteenth year, black clouds shrouded the western sky over Datong Circuit, booming like thunder.

sentences.zh: 俄頃，有雲如火，交射中天，遍地俱見火光，以物觸地，輒有火起，至夜半，空中如有兵戈相擊之聲。

translations.literal: In a moment there was cloud like fire, shooting and crossing at mid-heaven; everywhere flames were seen; where things touched the ground, fire would rise; by midnight, in the sky there seemed to be the sound of weapons clashing.
translations.idiomatic: Moments later, fiery clouds crossed the zenith, filling the land with visible flames; anything that touched the ground burst into fire, and by midnight the sky resounded as if with clashing weapons.

sentences.zh: 二十一年七月己巳，冀寧路忻州西北，有赤氣蔽空如血，逾時方散。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the seventh month of the twenty-first year, northwest of Xin Prefecture in Jining Circuit, there was red vapor veiling the sky like blood; only after some time did it disperse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the seventh month of the twenty-first year, blood-red vapor blanketed the northwestern sky over Xin Prefecture in Jining Circuit before finally dispersing.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，棣州夜半有赤氣亙天，起西北至於東北。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the eighth month, at Di Prefecture at midnight there was red vapor spanning heaven, rising from the northwest to the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eighth month, a crimson vapor streak stretched across the midnight sky over Di Prefecture from northwest to northeast.

sentences.zh: 癸未，彰德西北，夜有紅氣亙天，至明方息。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, northwest of Zhangde, at night there was red vapor spanning heaven; only at dawn did it abate.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, red vapor filled the night sky northwest of Zhangde and did not fade until dawn.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，大同路北方，夜有赤氣蔽天，直過天庭，自東而西，移時方散，如是者三。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, north of Datong Circuit, at night there was red vapor veiling heaven, passing straight through the celestial court from east to west; only after some time did it disperse—this happened three times.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, north of Datong Circuit, a scarlet vapor veiled the sky at night, cutting straight through the zenith from east to west; it dispersed only after some time—and this occurred three times.

sentences.zh: 十月癸巳昧爽，絳州有紅氣見於北方，如火。

translations.literal: At daybreak on the guisi day of the tenth month, Jiang Prefecture had red vapor appear in the north, like fire.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak on the guisi day of the tenth month, fire-like red vapor appeared in the northern sky over Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十三年三月壬戌，大同路夜有赤氣亙天，中侵北斗。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the third month of the twenty-third year, at Datong Circuit at night there was red vapor spanning heaven, invading the Northern Dipper at the center.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the third month of the twenty-third year, crimson vapor filled the night sky over Datong Circuit, encroaching upon the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，絳州日暮有紅光見於北方，如火，中有黑氣相雜，又有白虹二，直沖北斗，逾時方散。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the sixth month, at Jiang Prefecture at dusk there was red light in the north like fire, with black vapor mixed in; there were also two white rainbows, shooting straight toward the Northern Dipper; only after some time did they disperse.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the sixth month at dusk, fire-like red light appeared in the north over Jiang Prefecture, mingled with black vapor; two white rainbows pierced straight toward the Northern Dipper before finally dissipating.

sentences.zh: 庚申，晉寧路北方，日暮天赤，中有白氣如虹者三，一貫北斗，一貫北極，一貫天潢，至夜分方滅。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, north of Jinning Circuit, at dusk the sky was red; within it were three white vapors like rainbows—one passing through the Northern Dipper, one through the Celestial Pole, and one through the Celestial Bridge; only at midnight did they fade.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day at dusk north of Jinning Circuit, the sky turned red with three white arcs like rainbows—one crossing the Northern Dipper, one the Celestial Pole, and one the Celestial Bridge—before fading at midnight.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，忻州東北，夜有赤氣亙天，中有白色如蛇形，徐徐而行，逾時方散。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the eighth month, northeast of Xin Prefecture, at night there was red vapor spanning heaven; within it was something white like a serpent's form, moving slowly; only after some time did it disperse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the eighth month, northeast of Xin Prefecture, crimson vapor filled the night sky with a white serpent-like form gliding slowly through it before dissipating.

sentences.zh: 十月丙申朔，大名路向青、齊一方，有赤氣照耀千里。

translations.literal: On the bingshen new moon of the tenth month, Daming Circuit toward Qing and Qi had red vapor shining for a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month, crimson light blazed for a thousand li over Daming Circuit toward the Qing and Qi regions.

sentences.zh: 二十四年九月癸酉，冀寧平晉縣西北方，至夜天紅半壁，有頃，從東而散。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the ninth month of the twenty-fourth year, northwest of Pingjin County in Jining, by night half the sky was red; after a while it dispersed from the east.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the ninth month of the twenty-fourth year, the northwestern sky over Pingjin County in Jining turned red at night, half the heavens glowing before fading from the east.

sentences.zh: 二十八年六月壬寅，彰德路天寧寺塔忽變紅色，自頂至踵，表裏透徹，如煆鐵初出於爐，頂上有光焰迸發，自二更至五更乃止。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, the pagoda of Tianning Temple in Zhangde Circuit suddenly turned red, from crown to base, inside and out transparent and clear, like iron just drawn from the forge; at the top light and flame burst forth; from the second watch to the fifth watch it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, the pagoda of Tianning Temple in Zhangde Circuit suddenly glowed red from top to bottom, transparent inside and out like freshly forged iron, with flames bursting from its summit—from the second watch until the fifth watch before subsiding.

sentences.zh: 癸卯、甲辰，亦如之。

translations.literal: On the guimao and jiachen days, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao and jiachen days, the same phenomenon occurred.

sentences.zh: 先是，河北有童謠云：「塔兒黑，北人作主南人客；

translations.literal: Before this, in Hebei there was a children's rhyme that said: "When the pagoda is black, northerners are masters and southerners are guests;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, a children's rhyme in Hebei ran: "When the pagoda turns black, northerners rule and southerners are guests;

sentences.zh: 塔兒紅，朱衣人作主人公。

translations.literal: When the pagoda is red, a man in vermilion robes becomes master of the house.
translations.idiomatic: When the pagoda turns red, a man in red robes becomes lord of the realm.

sentences.zh: 」七月癸酉，京師赤氣滿天，如火照人，自寅至辰，氣焰方息。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the seventh month, a red vapor filled the capital sky, like fire shining upon people; from the yin hour to the chen hour the fiery vapor abated.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the seventh month, crimson vapor filled the capital sky, blazing on people's faces like fire; from the yin to the chen hour before the flames subsided.

sentences.zh: 至元元年十二月，芝草生於荊門州當陽縣覆船山，一本五幹，高尺有二寸，一本二幹，高五寸有半，幹皆兩岐；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Zhiyuan, lingzhi grass grew on Fuchuan Mountain in Dangyang County, Jingmen Prefecture; one plant had five stems, one chi and two cun tall; one plant had two stems, five and a half cun tall; all stems were bifurcated;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Zhiyuan, lingzhi fungus sprouted on Fuchuan Mountain in Dangyang County, Jingmen Prefecture—one specimen with five stems standing one chi and two cun tall, another with two stems five and a half cun tall, every stem forked in two;

sentences.zh: 二本相依附，扶疏瑰奇，如珊瑚枝，其高者結為華蓋慶雲之狀。

translations.literal: The two plants leaned together and clung to each other, lush and wondrous, like coral branches; the taller ones formed shapes like a flowery canopy and auspicious clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The two specimens leaned against each other in luxuriant, coral-like branches; the tallest formed shapes resembling ritual canopies and auspicious clouds.

sentences.zh: 五年秋，芝草生於中書工部之屋梁，一本七幹。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fifth year, lingzhi grass grew on a roof beam of the Ministry of Works in the Secretariat; one plant had seven stems.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the fifth year, a seven-stemmed lingzhi fungus appeared on a roof beam of the Secretariat's Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 木不曲直

translations.literal: Wood fails to bend and grow straight
translations.idiomatic: Wood fails to bend straight

sentences.zh: 至元五年十一月癸酉，瑞州路新昌州雨木冰，至明年二月壬寅冰始解。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the eleventh month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, Xinchang Prefecture in Ruizhou Circuit had rain of wood ice; only on the renyin day of the second month of the following year did the ice melt.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the eleventh month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, freezing rain encased the trees of Xinchang Prefecture in Ruizhou Circuit; the ice did not melt until the renyin day of the second month the following year.

sentences.zh: 至正四年正月，汴梁路鄭州尉氏、洧川、河陰三縣及龍興靖安縣雨木冰。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Zhizheng, Weishi, Weichuan, and Heyin—the three counties of Zheng Prefecture in Bianliang Circuit—and Jing'an County in Longxing had rain of wood ice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of Zhizheng, freezing rain glazed the trees of Weishi, Weichuan, and Heyin in Zheng Prefecture, Bianliang Circuit, as well as Jing'an County in Longxing.

sentences.zh: 十一月，東平雨木冰。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Dongping had rain of wood ice.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, trees in Dongping were coated by freezing rain.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月壬午，冀寧保德州雨木冰。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the ninth month of the twelfth year, Baode Prefecture in Jining had rain of wood ice.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the ninth month of the twelfth year, freezing rain encased the trees of Baode Prefecture in Jining.

sentences.zh: 十四年冬，龍興雨木冰。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourteenth year, Longxing had rain of wood ice.
translations.idiomatic: That winter in the fourteenth year, freezing rain glazed the trees of Longxing.

sentences.zh: 二十五年二月辛亥，汴梁雨木冰，狀如樓閣、人物、冠帶、鳥獸、花卉，百態具備，羽幢珠葆，彌望不絕，凡五日始解。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the second month of the twenty-fifth year, Bianliang had rain of wood ice; its form was like towers and pavilions, people, caps and sashes, birds and beasts, and flowers—all hundred forms complete; feather banners and pearl pendants, filling the view without end; in all it lasted five days before the ice melted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the second month of the twenty-fifth year, freezing rain at Bianliang coated trees in fantastical shapes—pagodas, human figures, official regalia, birds, beasts, and blossoms of every kind, with feathered banners and jeweled finials stretching as far as the eye could see; the spectacle lasted five days before the ice melted.

sentences.zh: 至正三年夏，上都、大都桑果葉，皆有黃色龍文。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year of Zhizheng, at Shangdu and Dadu the leaves of mulberry trees and fruit trees all had yellow dragon patterns.
translations.idiomatic: That summer in the third year of Zhizheng, mulberry and fruit leaves at Shangdu and Dadu bore yellow patterns shaped like dragons.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，奉元桃杏實。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year, Fengyuan had peaches and apricots bearing fruit.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the ninth year, peach and apricot trees bore fruit out of season in Fengyuan.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月，汴梁祥符縣椿樹結實如木瓜。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, Xiangfu County in Bianliang had Toona trees bearing fruit like papayas.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, the Toona trees of Xiangfu County in Bianliang produced fruit resembling papayas.

sentences.zh: 十六年七月，彰德李樹結實如小黃瓜。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixteenth year, at Zhangde plum trees bore fruit like small cucumbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixteenth year, plum trees in Zhangde bore fruit the size of small cucumbers.

sentences.zh: 民謠云：「李生黃瓜，民皆無家。

translations.literal: A folk rhyme said: "When plums bear cucumbers, the people will all be homeless.
translations.idiomatic: A folk rhyme ran: "When plums grow cucumbers, people lose their homes.

sentences.zh: 」二十一年，明州松樹結實，其大有盈尺者。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, pine trees in Ming Prefecture bore fruit; some as large as filled a chi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, pine trees in Ming Prefecture produced cones; some measured more than a foot across.

sentences.zh: 八月，汴梁祥符縣邑中樹木，一夕皆有濕泥塗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, in Xiangfu County in Bianliang, within the town all trees overnight had wet mud smeared upon them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, every tree in the town of Xiangfu County, Bianliang, was coated overnight with wet mud.

sentences.zh: 至元二年五月乙卯，南陽鄧州大霖雨，自是日至於六月甲申乃止。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the fifth month of the second year of Zhiyuan, Nanyang and Deng Prefecture had great continuous rain; from that day until the jiashen day of the sixth month it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month of the second year of Zhiyuan, Nanyang and Deng Prefecture were deluged by torrential rains that did not cease until the jiashen day of the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，衛輝路淫雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, Weihui Circuit had excessive rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, Weihui Circuit was battered by unrelenting rain.

sentences.zh: 至正二年秋，彰德路霖雨。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the second year of Zhizheng, Zhangde Circuit had continuous rain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the second year of Zhizheng, Zhangde Circuit was soaked by prolonged rains.

sentences.zh: 三年四月至七月，汴梁路滎澤縣，鈞州新鄭、密縣霖雨害稼。

translations.literal: From the fourth month to the seventh month of the third year, Xingze County in Bianliang Circuit, and Xinzheng and Mi Counties in Jun Prefecture had continuous rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: From the fourth to the seventh month of the third year, prolonged rains ruined the harvest in Xingze County, Bianliang Circuit, and in Xinzheng and Mi Counties, Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，汴梁蘭陽縣，許州長葛、郾城、襄城，睢州，歸德府亳州之鹿邑，濟寧之虞城淫雨害蠶麥，禾皆不登。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year, Lanyang County in Bianliang, Changge, Yancheng, and Xiangcheng in Xu Prefecture, Sui Prefecture, Luyi in Bozhou of Guide Prefecture, and Yucheng in Jining had excessive rain that harmed silkworms and wheat; grain crops all failed.
translations.idiomatic: That summer in the fourth year, excessive rains destroyed silkworms and wheat in Lanyang County, Bianliang, Changge, Yancheng, and Xiangcheng in Xu Prefecture, Sui Prefecture, Luyi in Bozhou of Guide Prefecture, and Yucheng in Jining—and grain harvests failed everywhere.

sentences.zh: 八月，益都霖雨，饑民有相食者。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yidu had continuous rain; among the starving people some ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, prolonged rains struck Yidu, and among the famine-stricken there were cases of cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 五年夏秋，汴梁祥符、尉氏、洧川，鄭州、鈞州、亳州久雨害稼，二麥禾豆俱不登。

translations.literal: In the summer and autumn of the fifth year, Xiangfu, Weishi, and Weichuan in Bianliang, Zheng Prefecture, Jun Prefecture, and Bozhou had long rain that harmed the crops; both wheat crops and grain and beans all failed.
translations.idiomatic: Through the summer and autumn of the fifth year, weeks of rain ruined the harvest in Xiangfu, Weishi, and Weichuan in Bianliang, Zheng Prefecture, Jun Prefecture, and Bozhou—both wheat crops and all grain and beans failed.

sentences.zh: 河間路淫雨，妨害鹽課。

translations.literal: Hejian Circuit had excessive rain, obstructing the salt levy.
translations.idiomatic: Excessive rains in Hejian Circuit disrupted the salt tax collections.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，京師大霖雨，都城崩圮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, the capital had great continuous rain; the capital city walls collapsed and crumbled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year, torrential rains at the capital caused the city walls to collapse.

sentences.zh: 鈞州新鄭縣淫雨害麥。

translations.literal: Xinzheng County in Jun Prefecture had excessive rain that harmed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: Excessive rains destroyed the wheat crop in Xinzheng County, Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，高唐州大霖雨，壞官署民居。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year, Gaotang Prefecture had great continuous rain that destroyed government offices and common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year, torrential rains in Gaotang Prefecture destroyed government buildings and private homes.

sentences.zh: 歸德府淫雨浹十旬。

translations.literal: Guide Prefecture had excessive rain lasting ten ten-day periods.
translations.idiomatic: Guide Prefecture endured a hundred days of unrelenting rain.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，彰德路大雨害麥。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year, Zhangde Circuit had heavy rain that harmed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the tenth year, heavy rains destroyed the wheat crop in Zhangde Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十年七月，益都高苑縣、陜州黽池縣大雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twentieth year, Gaoyuan County in Yidu and Mengchi County in Shan Prefecture had heavy rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twentieth year, heavy rains ruined the harvest in Gaoyuan County, Yidu, and Mengchi County, Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十三年七月，懷慶路河內、修武、武陟三縣及孟州淫雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-third year, Henei, Xiuwu, and Wuzhi—the three counties of Huaiqing Circuit—and Meng Prefecture had excessive rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-third year, excessive rains destroyed the harvest in Henei, Xiuwu, and Wuzhi in Huaiqing Circuit and in Meng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十四年秋，密州安丘縣大雨。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-fourth year, Anqiu County in Mi Prefecture had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the twenty-fourth year, heavy rains struck Anqiu County in Mi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十五年秋，密州安丘縣，潞州，汴梁許州及鈞州之密縣淫雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-fifth year, Anqiu County in Mi Prefecture, Lu Prefecture, Xu Prefecture in Bianliang, and Mi County in Jun Prefecture had excessive rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the twenty-fifth year, excessive rains ruined the harvest in Anqiu County, Mi Prefecture, Lu Prefecture, Xu Prefecture in the Bianliang region, and Mi County in Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十七年秋，彰德路淫雨。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-seventh year, Zhangde Circuit had excessive rain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn in the twenty-seventh year, Zhangde Circuit was deluged by unrelenting rain.

sentences.zh: 至正六年八月，龍興進賢縣甘露降。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year of Zhizheng, sweet dew descended in Jinxian County, Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year of Zhizheng, sweet dew fell on Jinxian County in Longxing.

sentences.zh: 二十年十月，國子學大成殿松柏樹有甘露降其上。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twentieth year, at the Imperial Academy's Hall of Great Accomplishment, pine and cypress trees had sweet dew descend upon them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twentieth year, sweet dew descended upon the pine and cypress trees in the Hall of Great Accomplishment at the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 至正十年春，麗正門樓鬥栱內，有人伏其中，不知何自而至，遠近聚觀之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year of Zhizheng, within the bracket sets of the Lizheng Gate tower there was a man crouching inside; no one knew whence he had come; people near and far gathered to watch.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the tenth year of Zhizheng, a man was found crouching inside the bracketwork of the Lizheng Gate tower; no one knew how he had gotten there, and crowds gathered from near and far to stare.

sentences.zh: 門尉以白留守，達於都堂，上聞，有旨令取付法司鞫問。

translations.literal: The gate captain reported it to the resident commissioner; it reached the metropolitan offices; the emperor heard of it and issued an order to take him and hand him over to the judicial offices for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: The gate captain reported the matter to the resident commissioner, who forwarded it to the metropolitan offices; when the emperor heard, he ordered the man seized and handed over to the judicial authorities for questioning.

sentences.zh: 但雲薊州人，問其姓名，詰其所從來，皆惘若無知，唯妄言禍福而已，乃以不應之罪笞之，忽不知所在。

translations.literal: He only said he was a man of Jizhou; when asked his name and pressed as to whence he came, he was all vacant as if knowing nothing, only speaking wildly of fortune and disaster; he was therefore flogged for the offense of improper response, and suddenly he was nowhere to be found.
translations.idiomatic: He would only say he was from Jizhou; asked his name and origin, he seemed blankly ignorant and spoke only nonsense about fortune and calamity; he was flogged for giving improper answers, and then suddenly vanished without a trace.

sentences.zh: 至正二十年八月，慶陽，延安，寧、安等州野鼠食稼，初由鶉卵化生，既成牝牡，生育日滋，百畝之田，一夕俱盡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twentieth year of Zhizheng, Qingyang, Yan'an, and the prefectures of Ning and An had field rats eating the crops; at first they were born from quail eggs; once male and female were formed, breeding daily increased; fields of a hundred mu were all consumed in a single night.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twentieth year of Zhizheng, field rats devoured crops in Qingyang, Yan'an, and the prefectures of Ning and An; they first hatched from quail eggs, then bred prolifically as males and females multiplied—a hundred mu of farmland could be stripped bare overnight.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，泗州瀕淮兩岸，有灰黑色鼠，暮夜出穴，成群覆地食禾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, on both banks of the Huai River at Si Prefecture there were gray-black rats; at dusk and night they came out of their holes, swarming over the ground to eat grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, gray-black rats on both banks of the Huai at Si Prefecture emerged from their burrows at night in swarms that carpeted the ground and devoured the grain.

sentences.zh: 金不從革

translations.literal: Metal fails to follow the working and alteration
translations.idiomatic: Metal fails to follow the working/alteration

sentences.zh: 至正十年正月甲戌，棣州白晝空中有聲自西北而來，距州二十里隕於地，化為石，其色黑，微有金星散布其上。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the first month of the tenth year of Zhizheng, at Di Prefecture in broad daylight there was a sound in the sky coming from the northwest; twenty li from the prefecture it fell to earth and turned to stone; its color was black, with faint golden specks scattered upon it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the first month of the tenth year of Zhizheng, a sound came from the northwestern sky over Di Prefecture in broad daylight; twenty li from the city something fell to earth and turned to stone—black in color, with faint golden flecks scattered across its surface.

sentences.zh: 有司以進，遂藏之司天監。

translations.literal: The responsible offices presented it, and it was then stored in the Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities presented it to the throne, and it was deposited in the Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 十一月冬至夜，陜西耀州有星墜於西原，光耀燭地，聲如雷鳴者三，化為石，形如斧，一面如鐵，一面如錫，削之有屑，擊之有聲。

translations.literal: On the winter-solstice night of the eleventh month, at Yaozhou in Shaanxi a star fell on the western plain; its light illuminated the ground; sounds like thunder occurred three times; it turned to stone; shaped like an axe; one face like iron and one like tin; when shaved it produced flakes; when struck it made a sound.
translations.idiomatic: On the winter-solstice night of the eleventh month, a meteor fell on the western plain at Yaozhou in Shaanxi, lighting the ground as bright as day; thunder rolled three times before it turned to stone shaped like an axe—iron on one face, tin on the other—shaving produced flakes and striking rang out clearly.

sentences.zh: 十六年冬十一月，大名路大名縣有星如火，自東南流，尾如曳篲，墜入於地，化為石，青黑光瑩，狀如狗頭，其斷處類新割者。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter of the sixteenth year, at Daming County in Daming Circuit there was a star like fire flowing from the southeast; its tail like a trailing broom; it fell into the ground and turned to stone; dark green-black and lustrous; shaped like a dog's head; its broken edge like a fresh cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter in the sixteenth year, a fireball streaked from the southeast over Daming County in Daming Circuit, its tail trailing like a broom; it plunged to earth and turned to stone—dark green-black and gleaming, shaped like a dog's head with a break as clean as a fresh cut.

sentences.zh: 有司以進，太史驗視云「天狗也」，命藏於庫。

translations.literal: The responsible offices presented it; the Grand Astrologer examined it and said, "It is a Heavenly Dog"; an order was given to store it in the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities presented it to the throne; the Grand Astrologer inspected it and declared it a Heavenly Dog, and it was ordered stored in the treasury.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月己丑，建寧路甌寧縣有星墜於營山前，其聲如雷，化為石。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the fourth month of the nineteenth year, at Ouning County in Jianning Circuit a star fell before Yingshan; its sound like thunder; it turned to stone.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the fourth month of the nineteenth year, a meteor fell before Yingshan at Ouning County in Jianning Circuit with a thunderous crash and turned to stone.

sentences.zh: 二十三年六月庚戌，益都臨朐縣龍山有星墜入於地，掘之深五尺，得石如磚，褐色，上有星如銀，破碎不完。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the sixth month of the twenty-third year, at Longshan in Linqu County, Yidu, a star fell into the ground; digging five chi deep, they obtained a stone like a brick, brown in color, with silver-like flecks upon it, broken and incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month of the twenty-third year, a star fell to earth at Longshan in Linqu County, Yidu; dug up five feet deep, it proved to be a brown brick-like stone flecked with silver, shattered and incomplete.

sentences.zh: 至正九年，龍興靖安縣山石迸裂，湧水，人多死者。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhizheng, at Jing'an County in Longxing mountains and rocks burst open and water gushed forth; many people died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhizheng, mountainside rocks at Jing'an County in Longxing burst apart and water burst forth, killing many people.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，慶元奉化州南山石突開，其碎而大者，有山川人物禽鳥草木之文。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year, at Nanshan in Fenghua Prefecture, Qingyuan Circuit, rocks suddenly split open; among the fragments the large ones had patterns of mountains, rivers, people, birds, beasts, grass, and trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the tenth year, rocks on South Mountain at Fenghua Prefecture in Qingyuan Circuit suddenly split open; the largest fragments bore patterns of mountains, rivers, human figures, birds, beasts, grass, and trees.

sentences.zh: 二十七年六月丁卯，沂州東蒼山有巨石，大如屋，崩裂墜地，聲震如雷。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year, at Dongcang Mountain in Yizhou there was a great boulder as large as a house; it collapsed and fell to the ground; the sound shook like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year, a house-sized boulder on Dongcang Mountain in Yizhou split apart and crashed to the ground with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，廣西靈川縣臨江石崖崩。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the seventh month, the riverside cliff at Lingchuan County in Guangxi collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the seventh month, the riverside cliff at Lingchuan County in Guangxi gave way.

sentences.zh: 元統元年夏，紹興旱，自四月不雨至於七月。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Yuantong, Shaoxing had drought; from the fourth month it did not rain until the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Yuantong (1333), Shaoxing suffered drought with no rain from the fourth month through the seventh.

sentences.zh: 淮東、淮西皆旱。

translations.literal: Both Huaidong and Huaixi were drought-stricken.
translations.idiomatic: Both Huaidong and Huaixi were stricken by drought.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，湖廣旱，自是月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, Huguang had drought; from that month it did not rain until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, Huguang fell into drought and saw no rain from that month until the eighth.

sentences.zh: 四月，河南旱，自是月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Henan had drought; from that month it did not rain until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Henan suffered drought with no rain from that month through the eighth.

sentences.zh: 秋，南康旱。

translations.literal: In autumn, Nankang had drought.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Nankang was drought-stricken.

sentences.zh: 至元元年夏，河南及邵武大旱。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Zhiyuan, Henan and Shaowu suffered great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Zhiyuan, Henan and Shaowu were devastated by severe drought.

sentences.zh: 二年，蘄州、黃州、浙東衢州、婺州、紹興、江東信州、江西瑞州等路及陜西皆旱。

translations.literal: In the second year, Qizhou, Huangzhou, Quzhou, Wuzhou, and Shaoxing in Zhedong, Xinzhou in Jiangdong, Ruizhou in Jiangxi, and other circuits, as well as Shaanxi, all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, drought afflicted Qizhou and Huangzhou, Quzhou, Wuzhou, and Shaoxing in Zhedong, Xinzhou in Jiangdong, Ruizhou in Jiangxi, and other circuits, as well as Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是年四月，黃州黃岡縣周氏婦產一男即死，狗頭人身，咸以為旱魃云。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of that year, a woman of the Zhou family in Huanggang County, Huangzhou, gave birth to a male who immediately died; dog-headed and human-bodied; all regarded it as a drought demon.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of that year, a Mrs. Zhou of Huanggang County in Huangzhou gave birth to a stillborn boy with a dog's head and a human body—widely taken as the appearance of a drought demon.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，廣東南雄路旱，自二月不雨至於五月，種不入土。

translations.literal: In the sixth summer, Nanxiong Circuit in Guangdong had drought; from the second month it did not rain until the fifth month; seed could not enter the soil.
translations.idiomatic: That summer in the sixth year, Nanxiong Circuit in Guangdong endured drought from the second month through the fifth with no rain, and seed could not be sown.

sentences.zh: 至正二年，彰德、大同二郡及冀寧平晉、榆次、徐溝縣，汾州孝義縣，忻州皆大旱，自春至秋不雨，人有相食者。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhizheng, the two prefectures of Zhangde and Datong, Pingjin, Yuci, and Hugou counties in Jinning, Xiaoyi County in Fen Prefecture, and Xin Prefecture all had great drought; from spring through autumn it did not rain; there were people who ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhizheng, Zhangde and Datong prefectures, Pingjin, Yuci, and Hugou in Jinning, Xiaoyi in Fen Prefecture, and Xin Prefecture all suffered severe drought from spring through autumn without rain, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 秋，衛輝大旱。

translations.literal: In autumn, Weihui had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Weihui was stricken by severe drought.

sentences.zh: 三年秋，興國大旱。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year, Xingguo had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the third year, Xingguo suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 四年，福州大旱，自三月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Fuzhou had great drought; from the third month it did not rain until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Fuzhou endured severe drought with no rain from the third month through the eighth.

sentences.zh: 興化、邵武、鎮江及湖南之桂陽皆旱。

translations.literal: Xinghua, Shaowu, Zhenjiang, and Guiyang in Hunan all had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua, Shaowu, Zhenjiang, and Guiyang in Hunan all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 五年，曹州禹城縣大旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Yucheng County in Caozhou had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Yucheng County in Caozhou was devastated by severe drought.

sentences.zh: 夏，膠州高密縣旱。

translations.literal: In summer, Gaomi County in Jiaozhou had drought.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Gaomi County in Jiaozhou was drought-stricken.

sentences.zh: 六年，鎮江及慶元奉化州旱。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Zhenjiang and Fenghua Prefecture in Qingyuan had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Zhenjiang and Fenghua Prefecture in Qingyuan suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 七年，懷慶、衛輝、河東及鳳翔之岐山、汴梁之祥符、河南之孟津皆大旱。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Huaqing, Weihui, Hedong, Qishan in Fengxiang, Xiangfu in Bianliang, and Mengjin in Henan all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Huaqing, Weihui, Hedong, Qishan in Fengxiang, Xiangfu in Bianliang, and Mengjin in Henan all suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，益都臨淄縣大旱。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year, Linzi County in Yidu had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year, Linzi County in Yidu was stricken by severe drought.

sentences.zh: 五月，四川旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Sichuan had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Sichuan suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十年夏秋，彰德旱。

translations.literal: In the summer and autumn of the tenth year, Zhangde had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Through the summer and autumn of the tenth year, Zhangde was drought-stricken.

sentences.zh: 十一年，鎮江旱。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Zhenjiang had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Zhenjiang suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 十二年，蘄州、黃州大旱，人相食。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Qizhou and Huangzhou had great drought; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Qizhou and Huangzhou were devastated by severe drought, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 浙東紹興旱。

translations.literal: Shaoxing in Zhedong had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxing in Zhedong suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 臺州自四月不雨至於七月。

translations.literal: Taizhou from the fourth month did not rain until the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou saw no rain from the fourth month through the seventh.

sentences.zh: 十三年，蘄州、黃州及浙東慶元、衢州、婺州，江東饒州，江西龍興、瑞州、建昌、吉安，廣東南雄，湖南永州、桂陽皆大旱。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Qizhou and Huangzhou; Qingyuan, Quzhou, and Wuzhou in Zhedong; Raozhou in Jiangdong; Longxing, Ruizhou, Jianchang, and Ji'an in Jiangxi; Nanxiong in Guangdong; and Yongzhou and Guiyang in Hunan all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, severe drought afflicted Qizhou and Huangzhou; Qingyuan, Quzhou, and Wuzhou in Zhedong; Raozhou in Jiangdong; Longxing, Ruizhou, Jianchang, and Ji'an in Jiangxi; Nanxiong in Guangdong; and Yongzhou and Guiyang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，懷慶河內縣、孟州，汴梁祥符縣，福建泉州，湖南永州、寶慶，廣西梧州皆大旱。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Henei County and Meng Prefecture in Huaqing, Xiangfu County in Bianliang, Quanzhou in Fujian, Yongzhou and Baoqing in Hunan, and Wuzhou in Guangxi all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, severe drought struck Henei County and Meng Prefecture in Huaqing, Xiangfu County in Bianliang, Quanzhou in Fujian, Yongzhou and Baoqing in Hunan, and Wuzhou in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 祥符旱魃再見，泉州種不入土，人相食。

translations.literal: At Xiangfu the drought demon appeared again; at Quanzhou seed could not enter the soil; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: The drought demon appeared again at Xiangfu; in Quanzhou seed could not be sown, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 十五年，衛輝大旱。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Weihui had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Weihui suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 十六年，婺州、處州皆大旱。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Wuzhou and Chuzhou all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Wuzhou and Chuzhou were both devastated by severe drought.

sentences.zh: 十八年春，薊州旱。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighteenth year, Jizhou had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighteenth year, Jizhou was drought-stricken.

sentences.zh: 莒州、濱州、般陽淄川縣、霍州、鄜州、鳳翔岐山縣春夏皆大旱。

translations.literal: Juzhou, Binzhou, Zichuan County in Banyang, Huo Prefecture, Fu Prefecture, and Qishan County in Fengxiang all had great drought in spring and summer.
translations.idiomatic: From spring through summer, Juzhou, Binzhou, Zichuan in Banyang, Huo Prefecture, Fu Prefecture, and Qishan in Fengxiang all suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 莒州家人自相食，岐山人相食。

translations.literal: In Juzhou families ate one another; in Qishan people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In Juzhou families turned on one another in cannibalism; in Qishan people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 十九年，晉寧、鳳翔，廣西梧州、象州皆大旱。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Jinning and Fengxiang, and Wuzhou and Xiang Prefecture in Guangxi all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, Jinning and Fengxiang, and Wuzhou and Xiang Prefecture in Guangxi all suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 二十年，通州旱。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Tongzhou had drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, Tongzhou was drought-stricken.

sentences.zh: 汾州介休縣自四月至秋不雨。

translations.literal: Jiexiu County in Fen Prefecture from the fourth month until autumn did not rain.
translations.idiomatic: Jiexiu County in Fen Prefecture saw no rain from the fourth month through autumn.

sentences.zh: 廣西賓州大旱，自閏五月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: Bin Prefecture in Guangxi had great drought; from the intercalary fifth month it did not rain until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Bin Prefecture in Guangxi suffered severe drought with no rain from the intercalary fifth month through the eighth.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，河南洛陽、孟津、偃師三縣大旱，人相食。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Luoyang, Mengjin, and Yanshi counties in Henan all had great drought; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, Luoyang, Mengjin, and Yanshi in Henan were devastated by severe drought, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，山東濟南、廣西賀州皆大旱。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Jinan in Shandong and He Prefecture in Guangxi all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Jinan in Shandong and He Prefecture in Guangxi both suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 至元五年八月，京師童謠云：「白雁望南飛，馬劄望北跳。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, a children's rhyme in the capital said: "The white goose looks south to fly; the mazi looks north to leap.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, a children's rhyme in the capital ran: "The white goose looks south to fly; the mazi looks north to leap.

sentences.zh: 」至正五年，淮、楚間童謠云：「富漢莫起樓，窮漢莫起屋，但看羊兒年，便是吳家國。

translations.literal: " In the fifth year of Zhizheng, a children's rhyme between the Huai and Chu regions said: "Rich men, do not build towers; poor men, do not build houses; just watch for the Year of the Sheep, and it will be the kingdom of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth year of Zhizheng, a children's rhyme between the Huai and Chu regions ran: "Rich men, do not build towers; poor men, do not build houses; just watch for the Year of the Sheep, and it will be the kingdom of Wu.

sentences.zh: 」十年，河南、北童謠云：「石人一隻眼，挑動黃河天下反。

translations.literal: " In the tenth year, a children's rhyme in Henan and the north said: "A stone man with one eye will stir up the Yellow River and turn the realm upside down.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth year, a children's rhyme in Henan and the north ran: "A stone man with one eye will stir up the Yellow River and turn the realm upside down.

sentences.zh: 」十五年，京師童謠云：「一陣黃風一陣沙，千里萬里無人家，回頭雪消不堪看，三眼和尚弄瞎馬。

translations.literal: " In the fifteenth year, a children's rhyme in the capital said: "A gust of yellow wind, a gust of sand; for a thousand li and ten thousand li there are no households; turn back—the melting snow is unbearable to behold; a three-eyed monk plays with a blind horse.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifteenth year, a children's rhyme in the capital ran: "A gust of yellow wind, a gust of sand; for a thousand li and ten thousand li there are no households; turn back—the melting snow is unbearable to behold; a three-eyed monk plays with a blind horse.

sentences.zh: 」此皆詩妖也。

translations.literal: " All these are poetic omens.
translations.idiomatic: " All of these were poetic omens.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，郡邑皆相傳朝廷欲括童男女，於是市井鄉里競相嫁娶，倉卒成言，貧富長幼多不得其宜者，此民訛也。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan, throughout the commanderies and counties it was rumored that the court intended to round up boys and girls; thereupon in market towns and villages people competed to marry off their children; hasty matches were made; among rich and poor, old and young, many were ill matched—this was popular false rumor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhiyuan, rumor spread through every district that the court would round up boys and girls, whereupon towns and villages rushed into marriage; matches were made in haste, and many pairings among rich and poor, old and young, were ill suited—this was popular false rumor.

sentences.zh: 至正十年，彰德境內狼狽為害，夜如人形，入人家哭，就人懷抱中取小兒食之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhizheng, within the borders of Zhangde wolves caused harm; at night like human form, they entered people's houses weeping, took small children from people's arms, and ate them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Zhizheng, wolves ravaged the Zhangde region, appearing at night in human shape, entering houses wailing, snatching infants from people's arms and devouring them.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月，福州連江縣有虎入於縣治。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-third year, at Lianjiang County in Fuzhou a tiger entered the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-third year, a tiger entered the county government compound at Lianjiang in Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十四年七月，福州白晝獲虎於城西。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-fourth year, at Fuzhou a tiger was captured in broad daylight west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-fourth year, a tiger was captured in broad daylight west of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 至元二年七月，黃州蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Zhiyuan, Huangzhou had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Zhiyuan, locusts infested Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，懷慶、溫州、汴梁陽武縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, Huaqing, Wenzhou, and Yangwu County in Bianliang had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year, locusts struck Huaqing, Wenzhou, and Yangwu County in Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，膠州即墨縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, Jimo County in Jiaozhou had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year, locusts infested Jimo County in Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 至正四年，歸德府永城縣及亳州蝗。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhizheng, Yongcheng County in Guide Prefecture and Bozhou had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhizheng, locusts ravaged Yongcheng County in Guide Prefecture and Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年，東昌茌平縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Chiping County in Dongchang had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, locusts infested Chiping County in Dongchang.

sentences.zh: 十八年夏，薊州、遼州、濰州昌邑縣、膠州高密縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eighteenth year, Jizhou, Liaozhou, Changyi County in Weizhou, and Gaomi County in Jiaozhou had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That summer in the eighteenth year, locusts struck Jizhou, Liaozhou, Changyi in Weizhou, and Gaomi in Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 秋，大都、廣平、順德及濰州之北海、莒州之蒙陰、汴梁之陳留、歸德之永城皆蝗。

translations.literal: In autumn, Dadu, Guangping, Shunde, Beihai in Weizhou, Mengyin in Juzhou, Chenliu in Bianliang, and Yongcheng in Guide all had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, locusts infested Dadu, Guangping, Shunde, Beihai in Weizhou, Mengyin in Juzhou, Chenliu in Bianliang, and Yongcheng in Guide.

sentences.zh: 順德九縣民食蝗，廣平人相食。

translations.literal: In the nine counties of Shunde the people ate locusts; in Guangping people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunde's nine counties people ate locusts to survive; in Guangping people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 十九年，大都霸州、通州，真定，彰德，懷慶，東昌，衛輝，河間之臨邑，東平之須城、東阿、陽谷三縣，山東益都、臨淄二縣，濰州、膠州、博興州，大同、冀寧二郡，文水、榆次、壽陽、徐溝四縣，沂、汾二州，及孝義、平遙、介休三縣，晉寧潞州及壺關、潞城、襄垣三縣，霍州趙城、靈石二縣，隰之永和，沁之武鄉，遼之榆社、奉元，及汴梁之祥符、原武、鄢陵、扶溝、杞、尉氏、洧川七縣，鄭之滎陽、汜水，許之長葛、郾城、襄城、臨潁，鈞之新鄭、密縣，皆蝗，食禾稼草木俱盡，所至蔽日，礙人馬不能行，填坑塹皆盈。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Bazhou and Tongzhou in Dadu, Zhending, Zhangde, Huaqing, Dongchang, Weihui, Linyi in Hejian, Xucheng, Dong'e, and Yanggu counties in Dongping, Yidu and Linzi counties in Shandong, Weizhou, Jiaozhou, and Boxing Prefecture, the two prefectures of Datong and Jinning, Wenshui, Yuci, Shouyang, and Hugou counties, Yi and Fen prefectures, and Xiaoyi, Pingyao, and Jiexiu counties, Lu Prefecture in Jinning and Huguan, Lucheng, and Xiangyuan counties, Zhaocheng and Lingshi counties in Huo Prefecture, Yonghe in Xi Prefecture, Wuxiang in Qin Prefecture, Yushe and Fengyuan in Liaozhou, and Xiangfu, Yuanwu, Yanling, Fugou, Qi, Weishi, and Weichuan counties in Bianliang, Xingyang and Sishui in Zheng Prefecture, and Changge, Yancheng, Xiangcheng, and Linying in Xu Prefecture, and Xinzheng and Mi County in Jun Prefecture—all had locusts; they ate grain crops and grass and trees completely; wherever they went they blocked out the sun; they impeded people and horses so they could not travel; filling ditches and moats until full.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, locusts swarmed across an vast arc of territory—from Bazhou and Tongzhou in Dadu, Zhending, Zhangde, Huaqing, Dongchang, and Weihui to dozens of counties in Hejian, Dongping, Shandong, Weizhou, Jiaozhou, Datong, Jinning, Fen and Yi prefectures, Lu Prefecture, Huo and Xi prefectures, Liaozhou, and the Bianliang, Zheng, Xu, and Jun regions—devouring every crop, grass, and tree until the sky went dark, travel became impossible, and ditches and moats were filled to overflowing.

sentences.zh: 饑民捕蝗以為食，或曝幹而積之。

translations.literal: Starving people caught locusts for food, or sun-dried them and stored them up.
translations.idiomatic: The starving caught locusts for food, or sun-dried and stockpiled them.

sentences.zh: 又罄，則人相食。

translations.literal: When these too were exhausted, then people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: When even that was exhausted, people turned to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 七月，淮安清河縣飛蝗蔽天，自西北來，凡經七日，禾稼俱盡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, at Qinghe County in Huai'an flying locusts covered the sky; they came from the northwest; in all they passed for seven days; grain crops were all consumed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, flying locusts blotted out the sky at Qinghe County in Huai'an, sweeping in from the northwest for seven days until every crop was stripped bare.

sentences.zh: 二十年，益都臨朐、壽光二縣，鳳翔岐山縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Linqu and Shouguang counties in Yidu and Qishan County in Fengxiang had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, locusts infested Linqu and Shouguang in Yidu and Qishan in Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 二十一年六月，河南鞏縣蝗，食稼俱盡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-first year, Gong County in Henan had locusts; they ate the crops completely.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-first year, locusts at Gong County in Henan devoured every crop.

sentences.zh: 七月，衛輝及汴梁滎澤縣、鄭州蝗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Weihui and Xingze County in Bianliang and Zheng Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, locusts struck Weihui, Xingze County in Bianliang, and Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十二年秋，衛輝及汴梁開封、扶溝、洧川三縣，許州及鈞之新鄭、密二縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-second year, Weihui and Kaifeng, Fugou, and Weichuan counties in Bianliang, Xu Prefecture, and Xinzheng and Mi counties in Jun Prefecture had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-second year, locusts infested Weihui, Kaifeng, Fugou, and Weichuan in Bianliang, Xu Prefecture, and Xinzheng and Mi in Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，鳳翔岐山縣蝗。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Qishan County in Fengxiang had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, locusts struck Qishan County in Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 元統二年六月，彰德雨白毛，俗呼云「老君髯」。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Yuantong, Zhangde had rain of white hair; popularly called "the Old Lord's beard."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Yuantong, white hair fell like rain on Zhangde—popularly called "the Old Lord's beard."

sentences.zh: 民謠曰：「天雨氂，事不齊。

translations.literal: The people sang: "Heaven rains hair; affairs will not be settled.
translations.idiomatic: The people sang: "Heaven rains hair; affairs will not be settled.

sentences.zh: 」至元三年三月，彰德雨毛，如線而綠，俗呼云「菩薩線」。

translations.literal: " In the third month of the third year of Zhiyuan, Zhangde had rain of hair, like thread and green; popularly called "Bodhisattva thread."
translations.idiomatic: " In the third month of the third year of Zhiyuan, green thread-like hair fell on Zhangde—popularly called "Bodhisattva thread."

sentences.zh: 民謠云：「天雨線，民起怨，中原地，事必變。

translations.literal: The people sang: "Heaven rains thread; the people rise in resentment; in the Central Plain, affairs must change.
translations.idiomatic: The people sang: "Heaven rains thread; the people rise in resentment; in the Central Plain, affairs must change.

sentences.zh: 」六年七月，延安路鄜州雨白毛，如馬鬃，所屬邑亦如之。

translations.literal: " In the seventh month of the sixth year, Fu Prefecture in Yan'an Circuit had rain of white hair like horse mane; the subordinate districts were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month of the sixth year, white hair like horse mane fell on Fu Prefecture in Yan'an Circuit, and on its subordinate districts as well.

sentences.zh: 至正十三年四月，冀寧榆次縣雨白毛，如馬鬃。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year of Zhizheng, Yuci County in Jinning had rain of white hair like horse mane.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the thirteenth year of Zhizheng, white hair like horse mane fell on Yuci County in Jinning.

sentences.zh: 七月，泉州路雨白絲。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Quanzhou Circuit had rain of white silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, white silk fell like rain on Quanzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十八年五月，益都雨白氂。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighteenth year, Yidu had rain of white hair.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighteenth year, white hair fell like rain on Yidu.

sentences.zh: 十九年三月，興化路連日雨氂。

translations.literal: In the third month of the nineteenth year, Xinghua Circuit had rain of hair for consecutive days.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the nineteenth year, hair fell like rain on Xinghua Circuit for days on end.

sentences.zh: 二十五年五月甲子，京師雨氂，長尺許，如馬鬃。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year, the capital had rain of hair more than a chi long, like horse mane.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year, hair more than a foot long fell like rain on the capital, like horse mane.

sentences.zh: 二十七年五月，益都雨白氂。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year, Yidu had rain of white hair.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year, white hair fell like rain on Yidu.

sentences.zh: 至元四年八月丁丑，京師白虹亙天。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the eighth month of the fourth year of Zhiyuan, a white rainbow stretched across the sky in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the eighth month of the fourth year of Zhiyuan, a white rainbow arched across the sky over the capital.

sentences.zh: 至正二十二年，京師有白氣如小索，起危宿，長五百丈，掃太微。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Zhizheng, in the capital there was white vapor like a small cord, rising from the Weixin asterism, five hundred zhang long, sweeping through the Taiwei enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Zhizheng, a white vapor like a slender cord rose from the Weixin asterism over the capital, five hundred zhang long, sweeping across the Taiwei enclosure.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月癸卯，冀寧路保德州三星晝見，有白氣橫突其中。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year, at Baode Prefecture in Jinning Circuit three stars were visible in daytime; white vapor ran horizontally through them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year, three stars appeared in daylight at Baode Prefecture in Jinning Circuit, with white vapor streaking horizontally through them.

sentences.zh: 二十六年三月丁亥，白虹五道亙天，其第三道貫日。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the third month of the twenty-sixth year, five white rainbows stretched across the sky; the third pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the third month of the twenty-sixth year, five white rainbows arched across the sky, the third piercing the sun.

sentences.zh: 又氣橫貫東南，良久乃滅。

translations.literal: Again vapor ran horizontally across the southeast; after a long time it then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Another band of vapor streaked horizontally across the southeast and lingered for a long time before fading.

sentences.zh: 二十七年五月，大名路有白氣二道。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year, Daming Circuit had two bands of white vapor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year, two bands of white vapor appeared over Daming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十八年閏七月乙丑，冀寧文水縣有白虹貫日，自東北直繞西南，雲影中似日非日，如鏡者三，色青白，逾時方沒。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the intercalary seventh month of the twenty-eighth year, at Wenshui County in Jinning there was a white rainbow piercing the sun, from the northeast straight around to the southwest; within the cloud shadow it seemed sun yet not sun, like mirrors, three of them, greenish-white in color; after some time they then set.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the intercalary seventh month of the twenty-eighth year, a white rainbow pierced the sun at Wenshui County in Jinning, curving from northeast to southwest; within the clouds appeared three mirror-like disks that seemed sun yet not sun, greenish-white in hue, lingering for some time before vanishing.

sentences.zh: 稼穡不成

translations.literal: Grain crops do not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Earth fails to yield crops.

sentences.zh: 元統元年夏，兩淮大饑。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Yuantong, the two Huai regions suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the first year of Yuantong, the two Huai regions were devastated by severe famine.

sentences.zh: 二年春，淮西饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, Huai West had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year, Huai West suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 七月，池州饑。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Chizhou had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Chizhou was stricken by famine.

sentences.zh: 十一月，濟南、萊蕪縣饑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jinan and Laiwu County had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Jinan and Laiwu County suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 至元元年春，益者路沂水、日照、蒙陰、莒四縣及龍興路饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Zhiyuan, Yishui, Rizhao, Mengyin, and Ju counties in Yidu Circuit and Longxing Circuit had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Zhiyuan, Yishui, Rizhao, Mengyin, and Ju in Yidu Circuit and Longxing Circuit suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 夏，京師饑。

translations.literal: In summer, the capital had famine.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, the capital was stricken by famine.

sentences.zh: 是歲，沅州、道州、寶慶及邵武、建寧饑。

translations.literal: In that year, Yuan Prefecture, Dao Prefecture, Baoqing, and Shaowu and Jianning had famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Yuan Prefecture, Dao Prefecture, Baoqing, Shaowu, and Jianning all suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二年，順州及淮西安豐，浙西松江，浙東臺州，江西江、撫、袁、瑞，湖北沅州盧陽縣饑。

translations.literal: In the second year, Shunzhou; Anfeng in Huai West; Songjiang in West Zhe; Taizhou in East Zhe; Jiang, Fu, Yuan, and Ru in Jiangxi; and Luyang County in Yuan Prefecture, Hubei, all had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Shunzhou; Anfeng in Huai West; Songjiang in West Zhe; Taizhou in East Zhe; Jiang, Fu, Yuan, and Ru in Jiangxi; and Luyang County in Yuan Prefecture, Hubei, all suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 三年，大都及濟南、蘄州、杭州、平江、紹興、溧陽、瑞州、臨江饑。

translations.literal: In the third year, the capital; Jinan; Qizhou; Hangzhou; Pingjiang; Shaoxing; Liyang; Ruizhou; and Linjiang all had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the capital, Jinan, Qizhou, Hangzhou, Pingjiang, Shaoxing, Liyang, Ruizhou, and Linjiang all suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 五年，上都開平縣、桓州，興和寶昌州，濮州之鄄城，冀寧之交城，益都之膠、密、莒、濰四州，遼東沈陽路，湖南衡州，江西袁州，八番順元等處皆饑。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Kaiping County and Huan Prefecture at Shangdu; Baochang Prefecture in Xinghe; Juancheng in Puzhou; Jiaocheng in Jinning; Jiao, Mi, Ju, and Wei in Yidu; Shenyang Circuit in Liaodong; Heng Prefecture in Hunan; Yuan Prefecture in Jiangxi; Shunyuan and other places in the Eight Tribes region—all had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Kaiping County and Huan Prefecture at Shangdu, Baochang Prefecture in Xinghe, Juancheng in Puzhou, Jiaocheng in Jinning, Jiao, Mi, Ju, and Wei in Yidu, Shenyang Circuit in Liaodong, Heng Prefecture in Hunan, Yuan Prefecture in Jiangxi, and Shunyuan and other places in the Eight Tribes region all suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 六年，順德之邢臺，濟南之歷城，大名之元城，德州之清平，泰安之奉符、長清，淮安之山陽等縣，歸德邳州，益都、般陽、處州、婺州四郡皆饑。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Xingtai in Shunde; Licheng in Jinan; Yuancheng in Daming; Qingping in De Prefecture; Fengfu and Changqing in Tai'an; Shanyang and other counties in Huai'an; Pei Prefecture in Guide; and the four prefectures of Yidu, Panyang, Chuzhou, and Wuzhou all had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Xingtai in Shunde, Licheng in Jinan, Yuancheng in Daming, Qingping in De Prefecture, Fengfu and Changqing in Tai'an, Shanyang and other counties in Huai'an, Pei Prefecture in Guide, and the four prefectures of Yidu, Panyang, Chuzhou, and Wuzhou all suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 至正元年春，京畿州縣、真定、河間、濟南及湖南饑。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Zhizheng, the capital region's prefectures and counties; Zhending; Hejian; Jinan; and Hunan had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Zhizheng, the capital region's prefectures and counties, Zhending, Hejian, Jinan, and Hunan suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 夏，彰德及溫州饑。

translations.literal: In summer, Zhangde and Wenzhou had famine.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Zhangde and Wenzhou were stricken by famine.

sentences.zh: 二年，保德州大饑。

translations.literal: In the second year, Baode Prefecture had great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Baode Prefecture was devastated by severe famine.

sentences.zh: 三年，衛輝、冀寧、忻州大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: In the third year, Weihui, Jinning, and Xin Prefecture had great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Weihui, Jinning, and Xin Prefecture were devastated by severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 四年，霸州大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Bazhou had great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Bazhou was devastated by severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 東平路東阿、陽谷、汶上、平陰四縣皆大饑。

translations.literal: The four counties of Dong'e, Yanggu, Wenshang, and Pingyin in Dongping Circuit all had great famine.
translations.idiomatic: The four counties of Dong'e, Yanggu, Wenshang, and Pingyin in Dongping Circuit were all devastated by severe famine.

sentences.zh: 冬，保定、河南饑。

translations.literal: In winter, Baoding and Henan had famine.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Baoding and Henan were stricken by famine.

sentences.zh: 五年春，東平路須城、東阿、陽谷三縣及徐州大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, Xucheng, Dong'e, and Yanggu in Dongping Circuit and Xuzhou had great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year, Xucheng, Dong'e, and Yanggu in Dongping Circuit and Xuzhou were devastated by severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 夏，濟南、汴梁、河南、邠州、瑞州、溫州、邵武饑。

translations.literal: In summer, Jinan; Bianliang; Henan; Bin Prefecture; Ruizhou; Wenzhou; and Shaowu had famine.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Jinan, Bianliang, Henan, Bin Prefecture, Ruizhou, Wenzhou, and Shaowu all suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，陜西饑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Shaanxi had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Shaanxi was stricken by famine.

sentences.zh: 七年，彰德、懷慶、東平、東昌、晉寧等處饑。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Zhangde; Huaiqing; Dongping; Dongchang; Jinning; and other places had famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Zhangde, Huaiqing, Dongping, Dongchang, Jinning, and other places suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 九年春，膠州大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year, Jiaozhou had great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year, Jiaozhou was devastated by severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 鈞州新鄭、密縣饑。

translations.literal: Xinzheng and Mi counties in Jun Prefecture had famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xinzheng and Mi counties in Jun Prefecture suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十四年春，浙東臺州，江東饒，閩海福州、邵武、汀州，江西龍興、建昌、吉安、臨江，廣西靜江等郡皆大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year, Taizhou in East Zhe; Rao in Jiang East; Fuzhou, Shaowu, and Tingzhou on the Min Sea coast; Longxing, Jianchang, Ji'an, and Linjiang in Jiangxi; and Jingjiang and other prefectures in Guangxi all had great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourteenth year, Taizhou in East Zhe, Rao in Jiang East, Fuzhou, Shaowu, and Tingzhou on the Min Sea coast, Longxing, Jianchang, Ji'an, and Linjiang in Jiangxi, and Jingjiang and other prefectures in Guangxi were all devastated by severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 十七年，河南大饑。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Henan had great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Henan was devastated by severe famine.

sentences.zh: 十八年春，莒州蒙陰縣大饑，斗米金一斤。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighteenth year, Mengyin County in Juzhou had great famine; a dou of rice cost one jin of gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighteenth year, Mengyin County in Juzhou was devastated by severe famine, and a dou of rice cost one jin of gold.

sentences.zh: 冬，京師大饑，人相食，彰德、山東亦如之。

translations.literal: In winter, the capital had great famine and people ate one another; Zhangde and Shandong were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, the capital was devastated by severe famine and people resorted to cannibalism; Zhangde and Shandong suffered the same fate.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月至五月，京師大饑，銀一錠得米僅八斗，死者無算。

translations.literal: From the first to the fifth month of the nineteenth year, the capital had great famine; one ingot of silver bought only eight dou of rice; the dead were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: From the first to the fifth month of the nineteenth year, the capital was devastated by severe famine; one ingot of silver bought only eight dou of rice, and the dead were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 通州民劉五殺其子而食之。

translations.literal: Liu Wu, a commoner of Tongzhou, killed his son and ate him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wu, a commoner of Tongzhou, killed his son and ate him.

sentences.zh: 保定路莩死盈道，軍士掠孱弱以為食。

translations.literal: Unburied corpses of the starved filled the roads in Baoding Circuit, and soldiers seized the weak to use as food.
translations.idiomatic: Unburied corpses of the starved filled the roads in Baoding Circuit, and soldiers seized the weak and used them for food.

sentences.zh: 濟南及益都之高苑，莒之蒙陰，河南之孟津、新安、黽池等縣皆大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: Jinan; Gaoyuan in Yidu; Mengyin in Ju; and Mengjin, Xin'an, and Mianchi counties in Henan all had great famine; people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan, Gaoyuan in Yidu, Mengyin in Ju, and Mengjin, Xin'an, and Mianchi in Henan were all devastated by severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，霸州饑，民多莩死。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Bazhou had famine; many commoners died of starvation in the streets.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Bazhou suffered famine, and many commoners died of starvation in the streets.

sentences.zh: 至正四年，福州、邵武、延平、汀州四郡，夏秋大疫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhizheng, the four prefectures of Fuzhou, Shaowu, Yanping, and Tingzhou had a great plague in summer and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhizheng, the four prefectures of Fuzhou, Shaowu, Yanping, and Tingzhou were stricken by a severe plague in summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 五年春夏，濟南大疫。

translations.literal: In the spring and summer of the fifth year, Jinan had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring and summer of the fifth year, Jinan was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月，冀寧保德州大疫。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year, Baode Prefecture in Jinning had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twelfth year, Baode Prefecture in Jinning was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 夏，龍興大疫。

translations.literal: In summer, Longxing had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Longxing was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 十三年，黃州、饒州大疫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Huang Prefecture and Raozhou had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Huang Prefecture and Raozhou were stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 十二月，大同路大疫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Datong Circuit had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Datong Circuit was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，河南大疫。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year, Henan had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixteenth year, Henan was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月，莒州蒙陰縣大疫。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, Mengyin County in Juzhou had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, Mengyin County in Juzhou was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 十八年夏，汾州大疫。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eighteenth year, Fen Prefecture had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eighteenth year, Fen Prefecture was stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 十九年春夏，鄜州並原縣，莒州沂水、日照二縣及廣東南雄路大疫。

translations.literal: In the spring and summer of the nineteenth year, Bingyuan County in Fu Prefecture; Yishui and Rizhao counties in Juzhou; and Nanxiong Circuit in Guangdong had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring and summer of the nineteenth year, Bingyuan County in Fu Prefecture, Yishui and Rizhao in Juzhou, and Nanxiong Circuit in Guangdong were stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 二十年夏，紹興山陰、會稽二縣大疫。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twentieth year, Shanyin and Kuaiji counties in Shaoxing had a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twentieth year, Shanyin and Kuaiji in Shaoxing were stricken by a severe plague.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，又大疫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, there was again a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, a severe plague struck again.

sentences.zh: 至正元年七月，廣西雷州颶風大作，湧潮水，拔木害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhizheng, a great hurricane arose in Leizhou, Guangxi; tide waters surged, uprooting trees and damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Zhizheng, a violent hurricane struck Leizhou in Guangxi, surging tide waters, uprooting trees, and ruining the harvest.

sentences.zh: 二年十月，海州颶風作，海水漲，溺死人民。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year, a hurricane arose at Haizhou; the sea rose and drowned people.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year, a hurricane struck Haizhou; the sea surged inland and drowned people.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月乙丑，潯州颶風大作，壞官舍民居，屋瓦門扉皆飄揚七里之外。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the fifth month of the thirteenth year, a great hurricane arose in Xun Prefecture, destroying government offices and private dwellings; roof tiles and doors were blown seven li away.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fifth month of the thirteenth year, a violent hurricane struck Xun Prefecture, destroying government offices and private dwellings and blowing roof tiles and doors seven li away.

sentences.zh: 十四年七月甲子，潞州襄垣縣大風拔木偃禾。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the seventh month of the fourteenth year, a great wind at Xiangyuan County in Lu Prefecture uprooted trees and flattened the grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the seventh month of the fourteenth year, a violent wind at Xiangyuan County in Lu Prefecture uprooted trees and flattened the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月癸酉，石州大風拔木，六畜皆鳴，人持槍矛，忽生火焰，抹之即無，搖之即有。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the first month of the twenty-first year, a great wind at Shi Prefecture uprooted trees; all livestock cried out; people holding spears and halberds suddenly saw flames appear on them—rub them and they vanished, shake them and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the first month of the twenty-first year, a violent wind at Shi Prefecture uprooted trees; all livestock cried out; and people holding spears and halberds suddenly saw flames appear on the weapons—rub them and the flames vanished, shake them and they returned.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，臺州路黃巖州海溢，颶風拔木，禾盡偃。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the sea overflowed at Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Circuit; a hurricane uprooted trees, and all the grain was flattened.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, the sea overflowed at Huangyan Prefecture in Taizhou Circuit; a hurricane uprooted trees and flattened the entire harvest.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月庚子，京師有大風，起自西北，飛砂揚礫，昏塵蔽天，逾時，風勢八面俱至，終夜不止，如是者連日。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the third month of the twenty-seventh year, a great wind arose in the capital from the northwest, hurling sand and pebbles; dust darkened the sky; after a time winds came from all eight directions, continuing through the night without cease, and so it went day after day.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the third month of the twenty-seventh year, a great wind arose in the capital from the northwest, hurling sand and pebbles until dust darkened the sky; after a time winds came from all eight directions and blew through the night without cease, and so it continued day after day.

sentences.zh: 自後，每日寅時風起，萬竅爭鳴，戌時方息，至五月癸未乃止。

translations.literal: Thereafter, wind arose daily at the yin hour, all passageways clamored with sound, and did not cease until the xu hour, continuing until the guiwei day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, wind arose daily at the yin hour, every opening clamored with sound, and did not cease until the xu hour, continuing until the guiwei day of the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 至正三年六月，梧州青蟲食稼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year of Zhizheng, green insects ate the crops at Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of Zhizheng, green caterpillars devoured the crops at Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，同州蟲食稼，郡守石亨祖禱於玄妙觀，寒雨三日，蟲盡死。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year, insects ate the crops at Tong Prefecture; the prefect Shi Hengzu prayed at the Xuanniao Abbey, and cold rain fell for three days until the insects all died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year, insects devoured the crops at Tong Prefecture; Prefect Shi Hengzu prayed at the Xuanniao Abbey, and after three days of cold rain the insects all died.

sentences.zh: 十九年五月，濟南章丘、鄒平二縣蝻，五穀不登。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year, locust nymphs infested Zhangqiu and Zouping counties in Jinan, and the five grains failed to ripen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year, locust nymphs infested Zhangqiu and Zouping in Jinan, and the five grains failed to ripen.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春，衛輝路螟。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year, there were stem borers in Weihui Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-second year, stem borers infested Weihui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 六月，萊州膠水縣虸蚄生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, armyworms appeared at Jiaoshui County in Laizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, armyworms appeared at Jiaoshui County in Laizhou.
