sentences.zh: 七月，掖縣虸蚄生，害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, armyworms appeared at Ye County, damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, armyworms appeared at Ye County and damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 二十三年六月，寧海文登縣虸蚄生。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-third year, armyworms appeared at Wendeng County in Ninghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-third year, armyworms appeared at Wendeng County in Ninghai.

sentences.zh: 七月，萊州招遠、萊陽二縣及登州、寧海州虸蚄生。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, armyworms appeared at Zhaoyuan and Laiyang counties in Laizhou and at Deng Prefecture and Ninghai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, armyworms appeared at Zhaoyuan and Laiyang in Laizhou and at Deng Prefecture and Ninghai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至正九年三月，陳州楊家莊上牛生黃犢，火光滿室，麻頂綠角，間生綠毛，不食乳，二日而死。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year of Zhizheng, at Yangjiazhuang in Chen Prefecture a cow calved a yellow calf; firelight filled the room; it had a hemp-spotted crown and green horns, with green hair here and there; it would not suckle and died in two days.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year of Zhizheng, at Yangjiazhuang in Chen Prefecture a cow calved a yellow calf amid firelight that filled the room; it had a pockmarked crown and green horns, with patches of green hair; it would not suckle and died within two days.

sentences.zh: 十年秋，襄陽車城民家牛生犢，五足，前三後二。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the tenth year, at Checheng in Xiangyang a commoner's cow calved a calf with five legs—three in front and two behind.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the tenth year, at Checheng in Xiangyang a commoner's cow calved a calf with five legs—three in front and two behind.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，汴梁祥符縣牛生犢，雙首，不及二日死。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year, at Xiangfu County in Bianliang a cow calved a two-headed calf that died in less than two days.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixteenth year, at Xiangfu County in Bianliang a cow calved a two-headed calf that died in less than two days.

sentences.zh: 二十八年五月，東昌聊城縣錢鎮撫家牛生黃犢，六足，前二後四。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-eighth year, at the home of Qian Zhenfu in Liaocheng County, Dongchang, a cow calved a yellow calf with six legs—two in front and four behind.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-eighth year, at the home of Qian Zhenfu in Liaocheng County, Dongchang, a cow calved a yellow calf with six legs—two in front and four behind.

sentences.zh: 至元五年二月，信州雨土。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, earth fell from the sky at Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, earth fell from the sky at Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至正三年三月至四月，忻州風霾盡晦。

translations.literal: From the third to the fourth month of the third year of Zhizheng, wind and haze at Xin Prefecture darkened everything.
translations.idiomatic: From the third to the fourth month of the third year of Zhizheng, wind and haze at Xin Prefecture darkened everything.

sentences.zh: 二十六年四月乙丑，奉元路黃霧四塞。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the fourth month of the twenty-sixth year, yellow haze blocked all four sides of Fengyuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fourth month of the twenty-sixth year, yellow haze closed in on Fengyuan Circuit from all sides.

sentences.zh: 元統元年八月，鞏昌、徽州山崩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yuantong, mountains collapsed in Gongchang and Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Yuantong, mountains collapsed in Gongchang and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，秦州山崩。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the ninth month, a mountain collapsed in Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the ninth month, a mountainside collapsed in Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，鳳州山崩。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day of the tenth month, a mountain collapsed in Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the tenth month, a mountainside collapsed in Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，鞏昌成紀縣地裂山崩。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day of the eleventh month, the earth split and mountains collapsed in Chengji County, Gongchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eleventh month, the earth split and mountains collapsed in Chengji County, Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，安慶灊山縣地震。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, there was an earthquake in Qianshan County, Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an earthquake struck Qianshan County in Anqing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，秦州地裂山崩。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, the earth split and mountains collapsed in Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the earth split and mountains collapsed in Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月，饒州德興縣，余幹、樂平二州地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, there were earthquakes in Dexing County, Raozhou, and in the two prefectures of Yugan and Leping.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, earthquakes struck Dexing County in Raozhou and the prefectures of Yugan and Leping.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，信州地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, there was an earthquake in Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year, an earthquake struck Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the eighth month, there was an earthquake in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the eighth month, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 雞鳴山崩，陷為池，方百里，人死者眾。

translations.literal: Jiming Mountain collapsed and sank into a pool a hundred li square; very many people died.
translations.idiomatic: Jiming Mountain collapsed and sank into a pool a hundred li square, and a great many people died.

sentences.zh: 至元元年十一月壬寅，興國路地震。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the eleventh month of the first year of Zhiyuan, there was an earthquake in Xingguo Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month of the first year of Zhiyuan, an earthquake struck Xingguo Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，安慶路地震，所屬宿松、太湖、灊山三縣同時俱震。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the twelfth month, there was an earthquake in Anqing Circuit; its subordinate counties of Susong, Taihu, and Qianshan all quaked at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the twelfth month, an earthquake struck Anqing Circuit, and its subordinate counties of Susong, Taihu, and Qianshan all quaked at once.

sentences.zh: 廬州、蘄州、黃州亦如之。

translations.literal: Luzhou, Qizhou, and Huang Prefecture were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou, Qizhou, and Huang Prefecture were likewise affected.

sentences.zh: 是月，饒州亦地震。

translations.literal: That month, Raozhou also had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Raozhou also experienced an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二年正月乙丑，宿松地震。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the first month of the second year, there was an earthquake in Susong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the first month of the second year, an earthquake struck Susong.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，秦州山崩。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the fifth month, a mountain collapsed in Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the fifth month, a mountainside collapsed in Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三年八月辛巳夜，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the xinsi night of the eighth month of the third year, there was an earthquake in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi night of the eighth month of the third year, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬午，又大震，損太廟神主；

translations.literal: On the renwu day, there was again a great quake that damaged the spirit tablets in the Imperial Ancestral Temple;
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, a great quake struck again, damaging the spirit tablets in the Imperial Ancestral Temple;

sentences.zh: 西湖寺神御殿壁仆，祭器皆壞。

translations.literal: The walls of the Imperial Spirit Hall at West Lake Temple collapsed, and all the ritual vessels were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The walls of the Imperial Spirit Hall at West Lake Temple collapsed, and all the ritual vessels were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 順州、龍慶州及懷來縣皆以辛巳夜地震，壞官民房舍，傷人及畜牧。

translations.literal: Shunzhou, Longqing Prefecture, and Huailai County all experienced earthquakes on the xinsi night, destroying government and private dwellings and injuring people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhou, Longqing Prefecture, and Huailai County all experienced earthquakes on the xinsi night, destroying government and private dwellings and injuring people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 宣德府亦如之，遂改為順寧云。

translations.literal: Xuande Prefecture was likewise, and thereupon it was renamed Shunning.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande Prefecture was likewise affected, and thereupon it was renamed Shunning.

sentences.zh: 四年春，保安州及瑞州路新昌州地震。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, there were earthquakes in Bao'an Prefecture and Xinchang Prefecture in Ruizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, earthquakes struck Bao'an Prefecture and Xinchang Prefecture in Ruizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 六月，信州路靈山裂。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Spirit Mountain split in Xin Prefecture Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Spirit Mountain split in Xin Prefecture Circuit.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，保安州地大震。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the seventh month, there was a great earthquake in Bao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the seventh month, a great earthquake struck Bao'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，鞏昌府山崩。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, a mountain collapsed in Gongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, a mountainside collapsed in Gongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，京師地震，日凡二三，至乙酉乃止。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the eighth month, there were earthquakes in the capital two or three times a day until the yiyou day, when they ceased.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the eighth month, the capital was shaken by earthquakes two or three times a day until the yiyou day, when they ceased.

sentences.zh: 密州安丘縣地震。

translations.literal: There was an earthquake in Anqiu County, Mi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck Anqiu County in Mi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六年六月己亥，秦州成紀縣山崩地裂。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the sixth month of the sixth year, mountains collapsed and the earth split in Chengji County, Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the sixth month of the sixth year, mountains collapsed and the earth split in Chengji County, Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至正元年二月，汴梁路地震。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Zhizheng, there was an earthquake in Bianliang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Zhizheng, an earthquake struck Bianliang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二年四月辛丑，冀寧路平晉縣地震，聲如雷鳴，裂地尺餘，民居皆傾仆。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the fourth month of the second year, there was an earthquake in Pingjin County, Jinning Circuit; the sound was like thunder, the earth split more than a chi, and all dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the fourth month of the second year, an earthquake at Pingjin County in Jinning Circuit roared like thunder, split the earth more than a foot deep, and toppled every dwelling.

sentences.zh: 七月，惠州雨水，羅浮山崩，凡二十七處，壞民居，塞田澗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, rain fell in Huizhou; Mount Luofu collapsed in twenty-seven places, destroying dwellings and blocking fields and streams.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, heavy rain fell in Huizhou; Mount Luofu collapsed in twenty-seven places, destroying dwellings and blocking fields and streams.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the twelfth month, there was an earthquake in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the twelfth month, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，鈞州新鄭、密縣地震。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, there were earthquakes in Xinzheng and Mi counties in Jun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year, earthquakes struck Xinzheng and Mi in Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，秦州秦安縣南坡崩裂，壓死人畜。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the sixth month, the southern slope collapsed and split at Qin'an County, Qin Prefecture, crushing people and livestock to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the sixth month, the southern slope collapsed and split at Qin'an County in Qin Prefecture, crushing people and livestock to death.

sentences.zh: 七月戊辰，鞏昌山崩，人畜死者眾。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the seventh month, a mountain collapsed in Gongchang, and very many people and livestock died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the seventh month, a mountainside collapsed in Gongchang, killing a great many people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 十二月，膠州及屬邑高密地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, there were earthquakes in Jiaozhou and its subordinate county of Gaomi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, earthquakes struck Jiaozhou and its subordinate county of Gaomi.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，莒州蒙陰縣地震。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, there was an earthquake in Mengyin County, Juzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year, an earthquake struck Mengyin County in Juzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，東平路東阿、陽谷、平陰三縣及漢陽地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, there were earthquakes in the three counties of Dong'e, Yanggu, and Pingyin in Dongping Circuit and in Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, earthquakes struck the three counties of Dong'e, Yanggu, and Pingyin in Dongping Circuit and Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 五年春，薊州地震，所領四縣及東平汶上縣亦如之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, there was an earthquake in Jizhou; the four counties under its jurisdiction and Wenshang County in Dongping were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year, an earthquake struck Jizhou, and the four counties under its jurisdiction and Wenshang County in Dongping were likewise affected.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，鎮江地震。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the twelfth month, there was an earthquake in Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the twelfth month, an earthquake struck Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，益都路益都、昌樂、壽光三縣，濰州北海縣、膠州即墨縣地震。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, there were earthquakes in the three counties of Yidu, Changle, and Shouguang in Yidu Circuit, in Beihai County in Wei Prefecture, and in Jimo County in Jiao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year, earthquakes struck the three counties of Yidu, Changle, and Shouguang in Yidu Circuit, Beihai County in Wei Prefecture, and Jimo County in Jiao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月，高苑縣地震，壞民居。

translations.literal: In the third month, there was an earthquake in Gaoyuan County, destroying dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, an earthquake struck Gaoyuan County, destroying dwellings.

sentences.zh: 六月，廣州增城縣羅浮山崩，水湧溢，溺死百餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Mount Luofu collapsed in Zengcheng County, Guang Prefecture; water gushed out and overflowed, and more than a hundred people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Mount Luofu collapsed in Zengcheng County in Guang Prefecture; water burst forth and overflowed, drowning more than a hundred people.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，邵武地震。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the ninth month, there was an earthquake in Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the ninth month, an earthquake struck Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 翌日，地中有聲如鼓，夜復如之。

translations.literal: The next day, within the earth there was a sound like drums; at night it was again thus.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, the ground rumbled like drums, and the same sound was heard again that night.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，益都臨淄、臨朐，濰州之昌邑、膠州之高密、濟南之棣州地震。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, there were earthquakes in Linzi and Linqu in Yidu, Changyi in Wei Prefecture, Gaomi in Jiao Prefecture, and Di Prefecture in Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year, earthquakes struck Linzi and Linqu in Yidu, Changyi in Wei Prefecture, Gaomi in Jiao Prefecture, and Di Prefecture in Jinan.

sentences.zh: 三月，東平路東阿、陽谷、平陰三縣地震，河水動搖。

translations.literal: In the third month, there were earthquakes in the three counties of Dong'e, Yanggu, and Pingyin in Dongping Circuit, and the river water surged.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, earthquakes struck the three counties of Dong'e, Yanggu, and Pingyin in Dongping Circuit, and the river waters churned.

sentences.zh: 五月，臨淄地又震，七日乃止。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the ground in Linzi quaked again; after seven days it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Linzi was shaken again by earthquakes that continued for seven days before subsiding.

sentences.zh: 河東地坼泉湧，崩城陷屋，傷人民。

translations.literal: In Hedong the earth split open and springs gushed forth; city walls collapsed and houses sank, harming the people.
translations.idiomatic: In Hedong the earth split open and springs burst forth; city walls collapsed and houses were swallowed, injuring many people.

sentences.zh: 十一月，鎮江丹陽縣地震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, there was an earthquake in Danyang County, Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, an earthquake struck Danyang County in Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，臺州地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, there was an earthquake in Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year, an earthquake struck Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 七月庚寅，泉州大風雨。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the seventh month, Quanzhou had great wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the seventh month, Quanzhou was hit by fierce wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 永春縣南象山崩，壓死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Mount Xiangshan south of Yongchun County collapsed, and very many were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Xiangshan south of Yongchun County collapsed, crushing a great many people to death.

sentences.zh: 十年，冀寧徐溝縣地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, there was an earthquake in Xugou County, Jinning.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, an earthquake struck Xugou County in Jinning.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，龍興寧州大雨，山崩數十處。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the fifth month, Ning Prefecture in Longxing had great rain, and mountains collapsed in several tens of places.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fifth month, heavy rain fell on Ning Prefecture in Longxing, and mountains collapsed in dozens of places.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，瑞州上高縣蒙山崩。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Mount Meng collapsed in Shanggao County, Ruizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Mount Meng collapsed in Shanggao County in Ruizhou.

sentences.zh: 十月乙酉，泉州安溪縣侯山鳴。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the tenth month, Mount Hou in Anxi County, Quanzhou, sounded.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the tenth month, Mount Hou in Anxi County in Quanzhou gave forth a loud rumbling.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，冀寧路汾、忻二州，文水、平晉、榆次、壽陽四縣，晉寧遼州之榆社，懷慶河內、修武二縣及孟州皆地震，聲如雷霆，圮房屋，壓死者甚眾。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, Fen and Xin prefectures in Jinning Circuit, the four counties of Wenshui, Pingjin, Yuci, and Shouyang, Yushe in Liaozhou, Jinning, the two counties of Henan and Xiuwu in Huaiqing, and Meng Prefecture all had earthquakes; the sound was like thunder; houses collapsed, and very many were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eleventh year, earthquakes struck Fen and Xin prefectures in Jinning Circuit, the four counties of Wenshui, Pingjin, Yuci, and Shouyang, Yushe in Liaozhou in Jinning, the two counties of Henan and Xiuwu in Huaiqing, and Meng Prefecture; the roar was like thunder, houses collapsed, and a great many people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，中興路公安、松滋、枝江三縣，峽、荊門二州地震。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the eighth month, there were earthquakes in the three counties of Gong'an, Songzi, and Zhijiang in Zhongxing Circuit and in the two prefectures of Xia and Jingmen.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the eighth month, earthquakes struck the three counties of Gong'an, Songzi, and Zhijiang in Zhongxing Circuit and the prefectures of Xia and Jingmen.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月丙戌，霍州靈石縣地震。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the second month of the twelfth year, there was an earthquake in Lingshi County, Huo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the second month of the twelfth year, an earthquake struck Lingshi County in Huo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 閏三月丁丑，陜西地震，莊浪、定西、靜寧、會州尤甚，移山湮谷，陷沒廬舍，有不見其跡者。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the intercalary third month, there was an earthquake in Shaanxi; Zhuanglang, Dingxi, Jingning, and Huizhou were especially severe—mountains were shifted and valleys buried, dwellings sank and were submerged, and some left no trace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the intercalary third month, an earthquake shook Shaanxi; Zhuanglang, Dingxi, Jingning, and Huizhou were hit hardest—mountains shifted and valleys were buried, dwellings sank without a trace.

sentences.zh: 會州公廨墻圮，得弩五百餘張，長丈餘，短者九尺，人莫能開挽。

translations.literal: The wall of the government office in Huizhou collapsed, and more than five hundred crossbows were found; the long ones were more than a zhang, the short ones nine chi, and no one could draw them.
translations.idiomatic: When the government office wall in Huizhou collapsed, more than five hundred crossbows were uncovered—some more than ten feet long, others nine feet—and no one could draw them.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，霍州趙城縣霍山崩，湧石數里，前三日，山鳴如雷，禽獸驚散。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the tenth month, Mount Huo collapsed in Zhaocheng County, Huo Prefecture; stones surged forth for several li; three days before, the mountain roared like thunder and birds and beasts fled in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the tenth month, Mount Huo collapsed in Zhaocheng County in Huo Prefecture, hurling stones for miles; three days earlier the mountain had thundered and birds and beasts had scattered in terror.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，莊浪、定西、靜寧、會州地震。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year, there were earthquakes in Zhuanglang, Dingxi, Jingning, and Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year, earthquakes struck Zhuanglang, Dingxi, Jingning, and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，汾州白彪山坼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Mount Baibiao in Fen Prefecture split open.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Mount Baibiao in Fen Prefecture split open.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，汾州介休縣地震，泉湧。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year, there was an earthquake in Jiexiu County, Fen Prefecture, and springs gushed forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year, an earthquake struck Jiexiu County in Fen Prefecture, and springs burst forth.

sentences.zh: 七月，孝義縣地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, there was an earthquake in Xiaoyi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, an earthquake struck Xiaoyi County.

sentences.zh: 十一月，寧國路地震，所領寧國、旌德二縣亦如之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, there was an earthquake in Ningguo Circuit; the two counties of Ningguo and Jingde under its jurisdiction were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, an earthquake struck Ningguo Circuit, and the two counties of Ningguo and Jingde under its jurisdiction were likewise affected.

sentences.zh: 淮安路海州地震。

translations.literal: There was an earthquake in Haizhou, Huai'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck Haizhou in Huai'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，紹興地震。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the twelfth month, there was an earthquake in Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the twelfth month, an earthquake struck Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 十五年四月，寧國敬亭、麻姑、華陽諸山崩。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year, Mounts Jingting, Magu, and Huayang in Ningguo collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year, Mounts Jingting, Magu, and Huayang in Ningguo collapsed.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，冀寧保德州地震。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the sixth month, there was an earthquake in Baode Prefecture, Jinning.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the sixth month, an earthquake struck Baode Prefecture in Jinning.

sentences.zh: 十六年春，薊州地震，凡十日，所領四縣亦如之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year, there was an earthquake in Jizhou; it lasted ten days in all, and the four counties under its jurisdiction were likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixteenth year, an earthquake struck Jizhou and continued for ten days; the four counties under its jurisdiction were likewise affected.

sentences.zh: 六月，雷州地大震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, there was a great earthquake in Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a great earthquake struck Leizhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年十月，靜江路東門地陷，城東石山崩。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventeenth year, the ground sank at the east gate of Jingjiang Circuit, and the stone mountain east of the city collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the seventeenth year, the ground subsided at the east gate of Jingjiang Circuit, and the stone mountain east of the city collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，慶元路象山縣鵝鼻山崩，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Mount Ebi collapsed in Xiangshan County, Qingyuan Circuit; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Mount Ebi collapsed in Xiangshan County in Qingyuan Circuit with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 十八年二月乙亥，冀寧臨州地震。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the second month of the eighteenth year, there was an earthquake in Lin Prefecture, Jinning.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the second month of the eighteenth year, an earthquake struck Lin Prefecture in Jinning.

sentences.zh: 五月，益都地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, there was an earthquake in Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, an earthquake struck Yidu.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月甲午，慶元地震。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the first month of the nineteenth year, there was an earthquake in Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the first month of the nineteenth year, an earthquake struck Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月，延平順昌縣地震。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twentieth year, there was an earthquake in Shunchang County, Yanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twentieth year, an earthquake struck Shunchang County in Yanping.

sentences.zh: 二十二年三月，南雄路地震。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-second year, there was an earthquake in Nanxiong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-second year, an earthquake struck Nanxiong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十三年十二月丁巳，臺州地震。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month of the twenty-third year, there was an earthquake in Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month of the twenty-third year, an earthquake struck Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十五年十月壬申，興化路地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the tenth month of the twenty-fifth year, there was an earthquake in Xinghua Circuit; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the tenth month of the twenty-fifth year, an earthquake shook Xinghua Circuit with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 二十六年三月，海州地震如雷，贛榆縣吳山崩。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-sixth year, there was an earthquake in Haizhou like thunder, and Mount Wu collapsed in Ganyu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-sixth year, Haizhou was shaken by an earthquake that roared like thunder, and Mount Wu collapsed in Ganyu County.

sentences.zh: 六月，汾州介休縣地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, there was an earthquake in Jiexiu County, Fen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, an earthquake struck Jiexiu County in Fen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 紹興山陰縣臥龍山裂。

translations.literal: Mount Wolong in Shanyin County, Shaoxing, split open.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Wolong in Shanyin County in Shaoxing split open.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，冀寧路徐溝縣，石、忻、臨三州，汾之孝義、平遙二縣同日地震，有壓死者。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the seventh month, there were earthquakes on the same day in Xugou County, Jinning Circuit, the three prefectures of Shi, Xin, and Lin, and the two counties of Xiaoyi and Pingyao in Fen Prefecture; some were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the seventh month, earthquakes struck on the same day in Xugou County in Jinning Circuit, the three prefectures of Shi, Xin, and Lin, and the two counties of Xiaoyi and Pingyao in Fen Prefecture, crushing some people to death.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，泉州同安縣大雷雨，三秀山崩。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, there was great thunder and rain in Tong'an County, Quanzhou, and Mount Sanxiu collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Tong'an County in Quanzhou was lashed by fierce thunder and rain, and Mount Sanxiu collapsed.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南府鞏縣大霖雨，地震山崩。

translations.literal: That month, Gong County in Henan Prefecture had great continuous rain, an earthquake, and mountain collapses.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Gong County in Henan Prefecture was deluged by heavy rains, shaken by an earthquake, and struck by mountain collapses.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，華州蒲城縣洛岸崩，壅水，絕流三日。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the eleventh month, the bank of the Luo River in Pucheng County, Hua Prefecture, collapsed, damming the water and blocking the flow for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the eleventh month, the Luo River bank collapsed in Pucheng County in Hua Prefecture, damming the river and cutting off its flow for three days.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，華州之蒲城縣洛水和順崖崩，其崖戴石，有巖穴可居，是日壓死辟亂者七十餘人。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, the Heshun Cliff on the Luo River in Pucheng County, Hua Prefecture, collapsed; the cliff bore stone and had rock caves in which one could dwell; that day more than seventy people fleeing chaos were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, the Heshun Cliff on the Luo River in Pucheng County in Hua Prefecture collapsed; the cliff was topped with rock and held caves where people had taken refuge, and that day more than seventy fleeing the chaos were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 二十七年五月，山東地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year, there was an earthquake in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year, an earthquake struck Shandong.

sentences.zh: 六月，沂州山石崩裂，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, a mountain stone in Yizhou split and collapsed; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a mountainside in Yizhou split apart and collapsed with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，靜江靈川縣大藏山石崖崩。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the seventh month, the stone cliff of Mount Dazang in Lingchuan County, Jingjiang, collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the seventh month, the stone cliff of Mount Dazang in Lingchuan County in Jingjiang collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，福州雷雨，地震。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the tenth month, there was thunder and rain in Fuzhou, and an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the tenth month, Fuzhou was hit by thunder and rain, and an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，又震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, there was another earthquake; there was a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the twelfth month, another earthquake struck with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 二十八年六月，冀寧文水、徐溝二縣，汾州孝義、介休二縣，臨州、保德州，隰之石樓縣及陜西皆地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, there were earthquakes in the two counties of Wenshui and Xugou in Jinning, the two counties of Xiaoyi and Jiexiu in Fen Prefecture, Lin Prefecture, Baode Prefecture, Shilou County in Xi Prefecture, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-eighth year, earthquakes struck the two counties of Wenshui and Xugou in Jinning, the two counties of Xiaoyi and Jiexiu in Fen Prefecture, Lin Prefecture, Baode Prefecture, Shilou County in Xi Prefecture, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，陜西地又震。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the tenth month, the ground in Shaanxi quaked again.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the tenth month, Shaanxi was shaken by another earthquake.
